AI.theoretical_framework: 动态权重收缩聚合（Dynamic Weighting Shrinking Aggregation）、闭形式训练范式（Closed-Form Training Paradigm）、差分隐私（Differential Privacy）
AI.method: 提出DWCFL-DP框架，采用权重收缩聚合机制和闭形式聚合规则，支持单周期本地训练，并通过差分隐私实现隐私保护；在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上进行多种Non-IID配置下的实验验证。
AI.findings: DWCFL-DP在全局准确率、收敛稳定性、对恶意或损坏客户端的鲁棒性以及通信效率方面均优于现有最先进基准方法；相比标准FedAvg，全局准确率提升高达10%，每轮训练时间减少约69.82秒，总通信量降低超过45%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将动态权重收缩聚合与闭形式训练范式相结合，为联邦学习在异构数据下的稳定性和泛化性提供了新的理论框架；降低了对手动超参数调优的依赖。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种在异构大规模环境中可扩展的隐私保护联邦学习解决方案，显著提升了通信效率和训练速度，便于实际部署。

title: Social Ties and Bank Deposit Flows
affiliations: University of Alabama - Culverhouse College of Commerce & Business Administration and

detail.title: Social Ties and Bank Deposit Flows
detail.abstract: We investigate whether uninsured deposit flows are less sensitive to the performance of banks from regions to which their depositor-base regions have stronger social ties. Using a novel measure of Bank Social Proximity based on Facebook social network data, we find that a one-standard-deviation increase in social proximity reduces deposit flow-performance sensitivity by approximately 50%, with the effect concentrated among poorly performing banks and significantly stronger when common factors drive bank performance. The effect weakens when strong political or religious ties already exist. Moreover, banks with greater social proximity experienced smaller stock price declines and less severe deposit outflows during the March 2023 banking stress. Overall, our findings highlight the role of social proximity in financial stability.

AI.tldr: 利用Facebook社交网络数据构建银行社会邻近度指标，发现社会邻近度每提高一个标准差，银行存款流动对银行绩效的敏感性降低约50%，这一效应在表现较差的银行中更为显著，且在2023年3月银行业危机期间社会邻近度更高的银行股价跌幅更小、存款外流更少，表明社会邻近度在金融稳定中发挥重要作用。
AI.research_question: 未保险存款流动对银行绩效的敏感性是否受到存款客户所在地区与银行所在地区之间社会联系强度的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注存款保险和硬信息对存款人行为的影响，但社会联系这一软信息渠道尚未被充分探索。理解社会联系如何影响存款人决策对金融稳定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论、社会信任理论、存款人行为理论
AI.method: 基于Facebook社交网络数据构建银行社会邻近度指标，采用回归分析检验社会邻近度对存款流动-绩效敏感性的调节效应，并进行异质性分析和稳健性检验。
AI.findings: (1)社会邻近度每提高一个标准差，存款流动对银行绩效的敏感性降低约50%；(2)该效应集中于绩效较差的银行，且在共同因素驱动银行绩效时更强；(3)当存在强烈的政治或宗教联系时，该效应减弱；(4)2023年3月银行业危机期间，社会邻近度更高的银行股价跌幅更小、存款外流更少。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会网络理论引入银行存款行为研究，揭示了社会邻近度作为非正式制度机制在降低信息不对称、缓解银行挤兑风险中的作用，拓展了金融稳定性影响因素的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理者提供通过建立社会联系来增强存款粘性和稳定性的策略参考；为监管者评估系统性风险提供社会网络视角的预警指标。

declarations.ethicsApproval: Approval was obtained from the Ethics Board of the College of Basic and Applied Sciences, University of Ghana (ECBAS 063/19–20), and the Ethics Review Committee of the Ghana Health Service (GHS-ERC 011/03/20) in Ghana. In Nigeria, ethical approval was obtained from the National Health Research Ethics Committee (NHREC/17/03/2018 and NHREC/01/01/2007). Across all countries, additional approval was sought from local authorities at all sampling sites.Written informed consent, including assent from minors (10-18 years) and consent from parents/guardians for participants below 18 years, was obtained before enrollment, questionnaire administration, and sample collection.

detail.abstract:
Background: Africa seemed to have had low SARS-CoV-2 infection and COVID-19 morbidity and mortality. While several studies reported high SARS-CoV-2 seropositivity among healthy Africans, others hypothesized that this could have resulted from pre-existing cross-reactive antibodies.  Our study tracks trends in seropositivity across three West African countries during the Delta and Omicron pandemic waves using a validated test kit with 98.9% predictive accuracy, 97% sensitivity, and 99% specificity.

Methods: Cross-sectional studies were conducted across three West African countries (Burkina Faso, Ghana, and Nigeria) with study sites conveniently selected in each country. Using the validated immunoassay kits, with already published validation procedures, SARS-CoV-2 antibodies were detected in peripheral blood during the ‘Delta’ and ‘Omicron’ waves. Participants' demographic and clinical data were obtained using a semi-structured questionnaire, and the primary outcome was the proportion of each population with SARS-CoV-2 antibodies.

Findings: Across the 3 countries, 20,748 participants were recruited, and the results showed SARS-CoV-2 IgG seropositivity ranging between 24.1% to 77.0%, which increased during the Omicron wave. All sites showed low self-reported vaccination rates, delinking seropositivity and vaccination. While there was a significant positive association between seropositivity and age across all sites, the association with other demographic factors was country-dependent, and most participants expressed positive opinions of vaccination.

Interpretation: This is one of the largest population-based SARS-CoV-2 seroepidemiology studies in Africa, confirming widespread mild SARS-CoV-2 infection in West Africa. This confirms a marked disconnect between high population exposure and low reported clinical burden, underscoring the need for strengthened community surveillance.

AI.tldr: 这是一项在三个西非国家（布基纳法索、加纳、尼日利亚）进行的大规模血清流行病学研究，发现在Delta和Omicron疫情期间，SARS-CoV-2 IgG血清阳性率介于24.1%至77.0%之间，且随着Omicron波而上升。研究证实西非存在广泛但轻微的SARS-CoV-2感染，揭示了高人群暴露与低临床负担之间的显著脱节。
AI.research_question: 在Delta和Omicron疫情期间，西非三国（布基纳法索、加纳、尼日利亚）的SARS-CoV-2血清阳性率趋势如何？
AI.motivation: 非洲地区报告的SARS-CoV-2感染率和COVID-19发病率、死亡率较低，但多项研究报告健康非洲人群中血清阳性率较高，有假设认为这可能是预先存在的交叉反应抗体所致。本研究旨在使用高准确度的验证检测试剂盒追踪西非三国在Delta和Omicron波期间的血清阳性率趋势，以澄清这一矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 血清流行病学理论；群体免疫与感染暴露理论。
AI.method: 横断面研究。在三个西非国家（布基纳法索、加纳、尼日利亚）便利选择研究地点，使用经验证的免疫检测试剂盒（预测准确率98.9%，敏感性97%，特异性99%），在Delta和Omicron波期间检测外周血中的SARS-CoV-2抗体。使用半结构化问卷收集人口统计学和临床数据，主要结局指标为各人群携带SARS-CoV-2抗体的比例。
AI.findings: 1. 共招募20,748名参与者，SARS-CoV-2 IgG血清阳性率介于24.1%至77.0%之间，且在Omicron波期间升高。2. 所有地点的自报疫苗接种率均较低，血清阳性率与疫苗接种脱钩。3. 血清阳性率与年龄呈显著正相关，但与其他人口学因素的关联因国家而异。4. 大多数参与者对疫苗接种持积极态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为非洲地区SARS-CoV-2实际感染率提供了大规模、高准确度的实证数据，证实了西非存在广泛但轻微的SARS-CoV-2感染，挑战了此前关于非洲低感染率的假设，并为"高暴露-低临床负担"悖论提供了血清流行病学证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示了高人群暴露与低临床报告负担之间的明显脱节，强调需要加强社区监测。2. 为非洲地区疫苗接种策略和公共卫生政策制定提供了关键数据支持。3. 验证了高准确度检测试剂盒在大规模血清流行病学研究中的可行性。

title: Beyond Screening: Evaluating the Clinical Transferability of AI Models to Complex Diagnostic Mammography
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), Emory University, Emory University, Emory University, Emory University, Emory University, Emory University, Victoria University of Wellington, National University of Singapore (NUS), National University of Singapore (NUS) - Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health, Emory University and Emory University - School of Medicine

detail.title: Beyond Screening: Evaluating the Clinical Transferability of AI Models to Complex Diagnostic Mammography

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study protocol was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Emory University (IRB0010801). The requirement for informed consent was waived due to the retrospective nature of the analysis involving de-identified data. Reporting follows the STARD 2015 guideline for diagnostic accuracy studies.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was, in part, funded by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) Agreement No. 1OT2OD032581.

detail.abstract:
Background: Artificial intelligence systems for mammography have demonstrated strong performance in screening populations, achieving diagnostic accuracy comparable to expert radiologists. However, their reliability in diagnostic mammography, which involves higher prevalence, non-standard protocols, and anatomically complex cases, has not been systematically evaluated.

Methods: We conducted a retrospective diagnostic accuracy study evaluating AI transferability from screening to diagnostic mammography at a single academic institution. We analysed 244,385 screening and 82,643 diagnostic examinations acquired between 2013 and 2020. Three AI architectures were compared: a vision-language foundation model (Mammo-CLIP), a standard convolutional neural network, and a medical foundation model (MedImageInsight). Performance was assessed using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and specificity at a fixed sensitivity threshold of 68·1%.

Findings: All three models achieved comparable screening performance (AUC 0·78-0·81). When applied to standard diagnostic views, Mammo-CLIP and EfficientNet showed statistically significant AUC reductions (ΔAUC −0·09, p<0·001 and ΔAUC −0·08, p=0·011), whereas MedImageInsight maintained screening-level discrimination (ΔAUC 0·00, p=0·92). In patients with breast implants, specificity dropped by 21-51 percentage points and AUC fell to 0·69-0·76. MedImageInsight achieved the highest performance on spot compression views (AUC 0·84). Lesion localisation was poor across all cohorts (mean intersection over union 0·136). Performance was consistent across racial and ethnic subgroups.

Interpretation: AI systems validated on screening mammography cannot be safely deployed to diagnostic populations without targeted adaptation. The performance degradation in patients with breast implants, affecting approximately 10% of adult women, represents an important safety gap. Foundation models offer improved robustness for diverse imaging protocols compared with standard CNNs, but poor localisation accuracy raises concerns about clinical interpretability. Clinical implementations should incorporate explicit patient selection criteria and context-specific probability thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了三种AI模型从筛查性乳腺摄影向诊断性乳腺摄影的迁移表现。研究发现：在244,385例筛查和82,643例诊断检查中，所有模型在筛查场景表现相当（AUC 0.78-0.81），但迁移至诊断场景后性能显著下降。乳腺植入物患者特异性下降21-51个百分点，病变定位准确性普遍较差（平均IoU 0.136）。基础模型（MedImageInsight）比标准CNN更稳健，但无法完全弥补迁移差距。
AI.research_question: AI系统能否可靠地从筛查性乳腺摄影迁移至诊断性乳腺摄影？不同AI架构（视觉-语言基础模型、标准CNN、医学基础模型）在迁移中的表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: AI在筛查性乳腺摄影中已展现出与专家相当的诊断准确性，但其在患病率更高、检查协议非标准化、解剖结构更复杂的诊断性乳腺摄影中的可靠性尚未得到系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 迁移学习理论、AI系统鲁棒性、基础模型 vs 传统CNN的泛化能力
AI.method: 回顾性诊断准确性研究，分析2013-2020年间244,385例筛查和82,643例诊断检查，比较Mammo-CLIP（视觉-语言基础模型）、EfficientNet（标准CNN）和MedImageInsight（医学基础模型）三种架构，使用AUC和固定敏感度68.1%下的特异度评估性能。
AI.findings: 1. 所有模型筛查性能相当（AUC 0.78-0.81）2. 诊断场景中Mammo-CLIP和EfficientNet的AUC显著下降（ΔAUC -0.09和-0.08），MedImageInsight保持稳定（ΔAUC 0.00）3. 乳腺植入物患者特异度下降21-51个百分点，AUC降至0.69-0.76 4. MedImageInsight在点压视野中表现最佳（AUC 0.84）5. 病变定位能力普遍较差（平均IoU 0.136）6. 种族亚组间表现一致
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了AI从筛查向诊断性乳腺摄影迁移时的性能下降幅度，揭示了乳腺植入物这一重要安全缺口，证明基础模型比标准CNN具有更好的协议鲁棒性，但指出定位能力不足是AI系统临床可解释性的关键瓶颈。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床部署AI乳腺诊断系统提供重要警示：筛查验证的AI不可直接用于诊断人群；建议加入患者筛选标准和场景特异性概率阈值；乳腺植入物患者（约10%成年女性）需要特别注意。

title: Latent Distress States, Financing Frictions, and Capital Structure Dynamics
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Latent Distress States, Financing Frictions, and Capital Structure Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether heterogeneity in capital structure adjustment reflects firms operating under different latent distress states. We distinguish between economic distress, which captures persistent deterioration in operating fundamentals and debt capacity, and financial distress, which captures liquidity shortages, refinancing pressure, and constrained access to external finance. We also identify mixed distress, where both mechanisms interact. Using a partial observability bivariate probit model, we estimate firm-year probabilities of latent distress states for U.S. publicly traded nonfinancial firms from 1993 to 2021 and incorporate these probabilities into dynamic leverage models. The results show that distress states have distinct implications for target leverage and speed of adjustment. Economic distress is associated with lower target leverage and faster deleveraging, particularly among highly levered firms, consistent with a structural reduction in sustainable debt capacity. Financial distress is associated with slower adjustment and persistent high leverage, suggesting that refinancing frictions restrict balance-sheet rebalancing. Mixed distress produces the strongest state dependence, consistent with a high-leverage trap in which operating weakness and financing frictions reinforce each other. External validation, panel VAR evidence, and indirect-cost tests indicate that the estimated states capture economically meaningful forms of corporate fragility. The findings imply that conventional leverage models may obscure important state dependence by pooling firms facing different sources of distress.

AI.tldr: 本文区分经济困境与财务困境两种潜在困境状态，发现它们对资本结构调整速度和目标杠杆率具有显著不同的影响，混合困境会导致“高杠杆陷阱”。
AI.research_question: 资本结构调整的异质性是否反映了企业处于不同的潜在困境状态？
AI.motivation: 传统资本结构模型通常将困境视为同质状态，忽视了经济困境（经营基本面恶化）与财务困境（流动性短缺、再融资压力）的差异，可能导致估计偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本结构动态权衡理论、困境成本理论、部分可观测双变量Probit模型。
AI.method: 使用部分可观测双变量Probit模型估计企业处于不同潜在困境状态的概率，并将其纳入动态杠杆模型，结合面板VAR和间接成本检验进行外部验证。
AI.findings: 经济困境导致目标杠杆率降低和快速去杠杆；财务困境导致调整缓慢且杠杆居高不下；混合困境产生最强的状态依赖，形成“高杠杆陷阱”。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了两种困境状态对资本结构调整的非对称影响，揭示了困境异质性的理论基础，丰富了动态权衡理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业财务困境预警、资本结构优化决策和债权人风险评估提供了更精细的分析框架。

title: Central Clearing and the Transmission of Intermediary Capital Shocks in CDS Markets
affiliations: Swansea University, Swansea University and Swansea University

detail.title: Central Clearing and the Transmission of Intermediary Capital Shocks in CDS Markets
detail.abstract: This study examines how the transition to central clearing reshapes the transmission of intermediary capital shocks to the Credit Default Swap (CDS) term structure. Using latent level, slope, and curvature factors extracted via a dynamic Nelson–Siegel framework and applied to a dataset of single-name CDS contracts derived on 149 European and U.S. reference entities over the period 2008–2012, we find that central clearing significantly moderates the sensitivity of CDS spread components to dealer capital constraints. Specifically, the sensitivity of the level factor increases, while clearing anchors the term-structure slope, thereby mitigating the risk of curve inversion during periods of intermediary distress. At the same time, curvature sensitivity intensifies, concentrating shock transmission at intermediate maturities, with amplification especially pronounced for European reference entities. These results demonstrate that central clearing fundamentally alters the maturity dimension of credit risk pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了向中央清算过渡如何重塑中介资本冲击对信用违约互换（CDS）期限结构的传导。通过动态Nelson-Siegel框架提取潜在的水平、斜率和曲率因子，并应用于2008-2012年间149个欧洲和美国参考实体的单名CDS合约数据集，发现中央清算显著缓和了CDS利差组成部分对交易商资本约束的敏感性。具体而言，水平因子的敏感性增强，而清算锚定了期限结构斜率，从而减轻了中介困境期间曲线倒挂的风险。同时，曲率敏感性加剧，将冲击传导集中在中期限，且对欧洲参考实体放大效应尤为显著。这些结果表明，中央清算从根本上改变了信用风险定价的期限维度。
AI.research_question: 中央清算如何改变中介资本冲击对CDS期限结构的传导机制？
AI.motivation: 中央清算被引入以降低交易对手风险，但其对资本约束冲击在CDS曲线不同期限上如何传导的影响尚未得到充分理解，尤其是危机时期曲线倒挂风险的变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态Nelson-Siegel框架（用于提取CDS期限结构的水平、斜率和曲率因子）以及中介资本约束理论。
AI.method: 使用动态Nelson-Siegel模型提取CDS期限结构的潜在因子，采用2008-2012年149个欧美参考实体的单名CDS数据，分析中央清算前后CDS利差成分对交易商资本约束敏感性的变化。
AI.findings: 1) 中央清算显著降低了CDS利差整体对交易商资本约束的敏感性；2) 水平因子敏感性增强；3) 斜率因子敏感性降低，曲线倒挂风险缓解；4) 曲率因子敏感性加剧，冲击集中于中期限；5) 欧洲参考实体的曲率放大效应更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了中央清算对CDS期限结构各维度因子（水平、斜率、曲率）冲击传导的非对称影响，拓展了中介资本约束理论在信用衍生品市场中的期限维度分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和市场参与者理解中央清算对信用风险定价的复杂影响提供了实证依据，特别是关于期限结构倒挂风险缓解和欧洲市场脆弱性的启示。

title: Entropy-Guided Resampling for Learning-Dynamics Improvementin Imbalanced Image Classification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Entropy-Guided Resampling for Learning-Dynamics Improvementin Imbalanced Image Classification
detail.abstract: Class imbalance remains a major challenge in image classification, particularly when minority classes contain visually ambiguous or fine-grained samples. Although transfer learning often provides strong baseline performance, it does not necessarily ensure a balanced learning trajectory across classes. This study proposes an entropy-guided resampling strategy that combines class rebalancing with uncertainty-based sample prioritization. Instead of duplicating minority-class samples uniformly, the proposed method preserves the original training samples and uses predictive entropy to select the additional duplicated samples required to balance each class. The method is evaluated across multiple image classification datasets by comparing baseline training, standard max resampling, and entropy-guided max resampling. The analysis emphasizes learning dynamics through AULC-F1, defined as the mean validation macro-F1 across validation checkpoints, together with best validation macro-F1 and balanced accuracy. Mean normalized entropy is also examined as a dataset-level descriptor of baseline predictive uncertainty. The results show that entropy-guided resampling improves AULC-F1 relative to the baseline across all evaluated datasets. Relative to standard resampling, the effect is dataset-dependent: clear gains are observed in UNODC and PathMNIST, marginal gains in HAM10000 and BloodMNIST, and no advantage in Zenodo and Wood. These findings indicate that entropy guidance is most useful when uncertainty-based sample prioritization contributes information beyond class-frequency correction alone. Mean normalized entropy helps characterize the uncertainty landscape, but it is not sufficient by itself to predict improvement, since gains also depend on within-class entropy heterogeneity, optimization behavior, and the informativeness of high-entropy samples. Overall, entropy-guided resampling offers a simple and practical mechanism for incorporating predictive uncertainty into imbalance-aware training, while its benefits should be interpreted as conditional rather than universal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于熵引导的重采样策略，通过预测性熵来选择需要重复的少数类样本，在多个图像分类数据集上实验表明该方法能改善AULC-F1，但效果依赖于数据集特性。
AI.research_question: 在类别不平衡的图像分类任务中，如何利用预测性不确定性（熵）来引导重采样策略，从而改善模型的学习轨迹和分类性能？
AI.motivation: 类别不平衡是图像分类的主要挑战，尤其在少数类包含视觉模糊或细粒度样本时更为突出。传统重采样均匀复制少数类样本，未考虑样本间的信息差异；迁移学习虽提供强基线性能，但不保证类别间的平衡学习轨迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息论中的熵（预测不确定性）概念，结合类别重平衡与不确定性导向的样本优先级排序，通过预测熵选择信息量更大的少数类样本进行复制。
AI.method: 提出熵引导的最大重采样（Entropy-Guided Max Resampling），保留原始训练样本，利用预测性熵选择额外复制的样本以达到类别平衡。在多个图像分类数据集上比较基线训练、标准最大重采样和熵引导最大重采样，使用AULC-F1（所有验证检查点的平均验证宏F1）、最佳验证宏F1和平衡准确率进行评估。
AI.findings: 熵引导重采样在所有评估数据集上均改善了AULC-F1；相对于标准重采样，效果因数据集而异：在UNODC和PathMNIST上有明显提升，在HAM10000和BloodMNIST上边际提升，在Zenodo和Wood上无优势。平均归一化熵不足以单独预测改进程度，增益还取决于类内熵异质性、优化行为和高熵样本的信息量。
AI.theory_contributions: 将预测不确定性（熵）系统性地整合到类别不平衡的重采样策略中，揭示了熵引导重采样的条件性效应，表明其优势依赖于数据集特性而非普遍适用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种简单实用的重采样方法，通过预测性熵替代均匀复制来选择需要重复的少数类样本，可在不过度复杂化训练流程的情况下改善不平衡学习效果。

title: DeMamba: Deformable Convolution Meets Mamba for Local–Global Semantic Reasoning in Agricultural Segmentation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: DeMamba: Deformable Convolution Meets Mamba for Local–Global Semantic Reasoning in Agricultural Segmentation
detail.abstract: Agricultural scene understanding through semantic segmentation plays a crucial role in modern agricultural intelligence, supporting phenological analysis, yield estimation, disease assessment, and efficient crop management. However, agricultural environments present unique challenges, including foreground–background ambiguity, occlusions, phenological variation, and large intra-class scale variation. Recent advances in semantic segmentation, including CNNs, transformers, and Mamba-based architectures, have achieved significant progress; however, each paradigm still exhibits inherent limitations in balancing fine-grained local detail and global context reasoning. In this work, we propose DeMamba (Deformable convolution meets Mamba), a novel architecture that integrates deformable convolution-based local feature modeling with efficient Mamba-based global context modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Global Semantic State Validation (GSSV) module to enhance long-range dependencies and an Adaptive Local–Global Fusion (ALGF) gated mechanism to effectively combine local and global representations. Furthermore, a two-stage training strategy with gate supervision and structure-aware stage loss is employed to improve segmentation consistency. Extensive experiments on a challenging UAV-based rice panicle dataset show that DeMamba consistently outperforms existing SOTA methods across multiple metrics (including +1.00% IoU, +2.13% Acc) and panicle sizes ranging from +5.04% (tiny) to +3.36% (large) IoU. Additionally, consistent gains on other agricultural tasks datasets, namely NLB (disease) and WGISD (fruit) further validate the generalization capability and robustness of the proposed approach. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeMamba架构，融合可变形卷积的局部特征建模与Mamba的全局上下文建模，并引入GSSV模块和ALGF门控机制，在农业场景语义分割任务中显著超越现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既能捕捉细粒度局部细节又能建模全局上下文的语义分割架构，以应对农业场景中的前景-背景模糊、遮挡、物候变化和类内尺度变化等挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有CNN、Transformer和Mamba架构在农业场景语义分割中各自存在局限，难以平衡局部细节与全局上下文推理；农业环境独特的挑战（如前景-背景模糊、遮挡、物候变化和尺度变化）亟需更有效的分割方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可变形卷积（Deformable Convolution）、状态空间模型（Mamba）、全局语义状态验证（GSSV）、自适应局部-全局融合门控机制（ALGF）、两阶段训练策略
AI.method: 提出DeMamba架构，集成可变形卷积的局部特征建模与Mamba的全局上下文建模；引入GSSV模块增强长距离依赖，设计ALGF门控机制融合局部和全局表征；采用两阶段训练策略，包含门控监督和结构感知阶段损失。
AI.findings: 在无人机水稻稻穗数据集上，DeMamba在IoU（+1.00%）、Acc（+2.13%）及不同稻穗尺寸（小+5.04% IoU、大+3.36% IoU）上均超越现有最优方法；在NLB（病害）和WGISD（果实）等其他农业任务数据集上同样取得一致提升，验证了方法的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将可变形卷积与Mamba有效融合的新架构范式，解决了局部细节与全局上下文推理的平衡问题；GSSV模块和ALGF门控机制为长距离依赖建模和特征融合提供了新的设计思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 在农业场景语义分割任务中实现了显著的性能提升，可应用于物候分析、产量估计、病害评估和作物管理；在多种农业数据集上验证了方法的泛化性，代码开源有助于推动农业智能化发展。

title: Mainstreaming Climate Action in Kenya's Coffee and Tea Value Chains: Climate Policy Integration and Green Trade under AfCFTA

detail.title: Mainstreaming Climate Action in Kenya's Coffee and Tea Value Chains: Climate Policy Integration and Green Trade under AfCFTA

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No Interest to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Nothing to declare
declarations.funderStatement: No funding provided

detail.abstract: Kenya's coffee and tea sectors are central to rural livelihoods and export earnings but are increasingly exposed to climate variability and long-term climatic shifts. Despite growing policy attention, limited empirical work has examined how climate action is operationalised within export-oriented agricultural value chains and its implications for development outcomes. This study applies a qualitative policy analysis and secondary data synthesis to examine the mainstreaming of climate action in Kenya's coffee and tea sectors, drawing explicitly on the Green Supplement to Kenya's AfCFTA Implementation Strategy as a policy innovation case. The Supplement positions trade as a vehicle for climate resilience by integrating sustainable production, regulatory alignment, and green market access within continental trade frameworks. The analysis shows that climate risks-manifested through reduced yields, increased pest and disease incidence, and declining product quality-are already undermining sector performance and smallholder livelihoods. In response, the Green Supplement advances regenerative agriculture, sustainable consumption and production practices, and carbon sequestration through agroforestry as core adaptation and mitigation pathways. It further introduces a structured theory-of-change framework linking policy instruments, value chain interventions, and resilience outcomes. However, implementation gaps persist, particularly in financing, addressing non-tariff trade barriers, and ensuring equitable participation of women, who contribute up to 70% of labour yet remain structurally disadvantaged. By conceptualising climate action across absorptive, adaptive, and transformative capacities, this study demonstrates that integrating climate policy with trade frameworks can enhance resilience while strengthening competitiveness in sustainability-sensitive markets. The Kenyan case provides a scalable model for embedding climate resilience within trade-driven agricultural systems across Africa.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定性政策分析和二手数据综合，考察肯尼亚咖啡和茶叶部门如何将气候行动纳入出口导向型农业价值链，以《绿色补充文件》为政策创新案例，展示了将气候政策与贸易框架整合可增强韧性并提升可持续竞争力，为非洲大陆提供了可扩展的模式。
AI.research_question: 气候行动如何在肯尼亚出口导向型的咖啡和茶叶农业价值链中实现操作化，及其对发展成果有何影响？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚咖啡和茶业对农村生计和出口收入至关重要，却日益受到气候变异和长期气候变化的威胁。尽管政策关注度上升，但关于气候行动如何在出口导向型农业价值链中操作化及其发展影响的实证研究仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 吸收性、适应性和变革性三种韧性能力框架；变革理论（Theory-of-Change）；将气候政策与贸易框架整合的分析视角。
AI.method: 定性政策分析与二手数据综合，以肯尼亚《非洲大陆自由贸易区实施战略绿色补充文件》为政策创新案例。
AI.findings: 气候风险（产量下降、病虫害增加、品质降低）已损害部门绩效和小农生计；绿色补充文件通过再生农业、可持续消费与生产、农林碳汇等路径推进适应与减缓；但存在融资不足、非关税贸易壁垒、妇女（占劳动力70%）结构性劣势等实施缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候行动概念化为吸收性、适应性和变革性三种韧性能力，为分析贸易框架下气候政策整合提供了系统性理论框架；建立了政策工具、价值链干预与韧性结果之间的变革理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚及其他非洲国家将气候韧性嵌入贸易驱动的农业系统提供了可扩展的政策模式；揭示了绿色贸易框架在提升可持续竞争力方面的潜力；指出了融资、贸易壁垒和性别平等等关键实施挑战。

title: DamViT: A Multi-scale Vision Transformer for Damage Detection in Structural Health Analysis of Concrete Dams
affiliations: COMSATS University Islamabad, University of Oslo - Oslo University Hospital, Riphah International University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: DamViT: A Multi-scale Vision Transformer for Damage Detection in Structural Health Analysis of Concrete Dams
detail.abstract: Structural health analysis (SHA) of dams and water reservoirs is essential for ensuring their long-term safety, durability, and operational reliability. Conducting timely assessments, however, remains challenging due to practicing visual inspection methods are prone to persistent moisture, efflorescence, complex illumination conditions, and natural occlusions such as vegetation. These factors significantly reduce the robustness and consistency of automatic damage detection. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel multi-scale Dam Vision Transformer (DamViT) architecture specifically designed for robust and automated damage detection and segmentation. DamViT utilizes a dual-branch framework: a Coarse branch that efficiently identifies potential damage regions by capturing global context and a Fine-grained branch that performs high-precision segmentation and delineation of specific defects, namely cracks and spalling, by extracting localized, high-resolution features. To facilitate rigorous development and evaluation, we meticulously annotated and compiled a high-quality dataset comprising 5,000 high-resolution image patches (512 x 512 pixels) of dam surfaces. Thorough Experimentation on the test set demonstrates the superior performance of the proposed approach. For damage detection, DamViT achieves mAP of 0.92 for cracks and 0.95 for spalling, and for segmentation, it attains mAP scores of 0.72 and 0.80, respectively. These results outperform well-established approaches (e.g., U-Net, DeepLabV3+, DeepCrack, CrackFormer) and recent YOLO variants. The proposed DamViT advances the state-of-the-art in SHA by enabling timely and reliable damage detection for cost-effective long-term infrastructure maintenance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DamViT的双分支多尺度视觉Transformer架构，用于水坝表面的裂缝和剥落自动检测与分割。该模型在5000张高分辨率图像数据集上实现了裂纹检测mAP 0.92、剥落检测mAP 0.95，以及相应分割mAP 0.72和0.80，显著优于U-Net、DeepLabV3+、DeepCrack等现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何克服水坝结构健康检测中因潮湿、泛碱、复杂光照和植被遮挡等因素导致的自动损伤检测鲁棒性不足的问题？
AI.motivation: 传统水坝结构健康分析依赖目视检查，但环境因素（潮湿、泛碱、光照不均、植被遮挡）严重削弱了自动损伤检测的鲁棒性和一致性，亟需一种更可靠、自动化的检测与分割方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于视觉Transformer的多尺度双分支架构：粗粒度分支捕获全局上下文以定位潜在损伤区域，细粒度分支提取局部高分辨率特征以实现高精度缺陷分割。
AI.method: 提出DamViT（Dam Vision Transformer）双分支架构，包含Coarse分支（全局上下文损伤区域识别）和Fine-grained分支（局部特征高精度分割）。构建了5000张512x512像素的高分辨率水坝表面图像数据集，并进行精细标注。
AI.findings: DamViT在检测任务中，裂缝mAP达0.92，剥落mAP达0.95；分割任务中，裂缝mAP达0.72，剥落mAP达0.80。性能全面优于U-Net、DeepLabV3+、DeepCrack、CrackFormer及YOLO变体。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了面向水坝结构健康分析的专用视觉Transformer架构，验证了双分支多尺度设计在复杂环境下的损伤检测有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为水坝等水利基础设施提供了自动化、高精度的损伤检测与分割工具，降低了人工巡检成本，支持长期经济高效的维护决策。

title: Beyond Post-hoc: Proactive Shortcut Mining and Targeted Verificationfor Visual Datasets
affiliations: North China University of Technology, North China University of Technology, North China University of Technology, North China University of Technology and North China University of Technology

detail.title: Beyond Post-hoc: Proactive Shortcut Mining and Targeted Verificationfor Visual Datasets

keywords.keywords: Shortcut learningSpurious correlationsProactive Multi-dimensional Shortcut MiningOOD verificationVisual robustness

detail.abstract: Deeplearningmodelsinvisualtasksmayexploitunintendedcorrelationsindatasets rather than robust task-relevant cues, leading to performance degradation under out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Although shortcut learning has become an important issue in visual robustness research, existing approaches mainlydependontrained modelanalysisorverification ofpredefinedshortcut types, making them insufficient for identifying latent multi-dimensional shortcuts in new datasets before model training. To address this limitation, we propose a proactive multi-dimensional shortcut mining and verification framework that integrates shortcut discovery before model training, automatic dimension specific OOD sample construction and validation. For each dataset, the framework systematically mines shortcut risks across eight dimensions, including background, co-occurring objects, color, texture, pixel-level patterns, position, size, and angle. The mined shortcut cues are quantified by the Potential Bias Score (PBS), while model-level shortcut dependency is measured by the Shortcut Association Score (SAS) ongenerated OODsamples.SystematicexperimentsonWaterbirds,ColoredMNIST, Visual Genome, and a self-constructed compound-shortcut dataset demonstrate that the framework can identify dominant shortcut cues, reveal co-existing multi-dimensional shortcut structures, and distinguish dataset-level shortcut cues from model-level dependency. The results further provide practical guidance for dataset diagnosis, targeted data revision, and lightweight mitigation to improve OOD generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种主动式多维捷径挖掘与验证框架，能在模型训练前系统性地发现数据集中的八维捷径线索，并通过PBS和SAS量化评估，有效提升OOD泛化能力。
AI.research_question: 如何在模型训练之前主动识别数据集中潜在的多维捷径（shortcut），并系统性地验证其对模型OOD泛化性能的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有捷径学习方法依赖已训练模型分析或预定义捷径类型的验证，无法在模型训练前自动发现新数据集中的潜在多维捷径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 捷径学习理论（Shortcut Learning）；多维捷径分类（背景、共现物体、颜色、纹理、像素级模式、位置、大小、角度）；潜在偏差分数（PBS）；捷径关联分数（SAS）。
AI.method: 提出一种主动式多维捷径挖掘与验证框架：①在模型训练前进行系统性捷径挖掘（覆盖八个维度）；②自动构建维度特定的OOD样本；③通过PBS量化捷径线索的强度，通过SAS衡量模型对捷径的依赖程度。
AI.findings: 在Waterbirds、ColoredMNIST、Visual Genome及自建复合捷径数据集上，该框架能够识别主导捷径线索、揭示共存的复合捷径结构，并区分数据集层面的捷径线索与模型层面的依赖关系。
AI.theory_contributions: ①提出了模型训练前主动挖掘多维捷径的新范式，突破了依赖已训练模型或预定义类型的局限；②系统定义了八维捷径空间及对应的量化指标PBS和SAS。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据集诊断、针对性数据修正和轻量化缓解策略提供了可操作指导，有助于提升模型在OOD场景下的泛化性能。

title: Do Dedicated Freight Corridors Cause Economic Growth in India? A Difference-in-Differences Analysis

detail.title: Do Dedicated Freight Corridors Cause Economic Growth in India? A Difference-in-Differences Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare no financial interest or conflict of interest in this research work.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper is fully self-funded (all resources used are free of cost).

detail.abstract: We provide the first causal district-level evaluation of India's Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC), exploiting the staggered commissioning of 33 stretches across 49 districts between 2020 and 2026. Using monthly nighttime satellite luminosity for 568 Indian districts over 87 months, we find that DFC commissioning is associated with an average 4.5% reduction in local economic activity (β =-0.046, p = 0.004), driven by a short-run disruption effect that dissipates within six to twelve months. Heterogeneity analysis reveals the effect is entirely concentrated in Eastern DFC districts (β =-0.067, p = 0.006), while Western DFC districts show no significant response. This is a divergence attributable to the absence of complementary industrial infrastructure in the Gangetic Plain. Results are robust to Callaway-Sant'Anna correction, district-specific time trends, and placebo testing. Our findings suggest that freight rail infrastructure alone is insufficient to generate local economic spillovers in lagging regions without complementary investment in industrial capacity and last-mile connectivity.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对印度专用货运走廊（DFC）进行区级因果评估，利用2020-2026年间49个区33个路段的交错开通数据，发现DFC开通导致当地经济活动平均下降4.5%，这一短期扰动效应在6-12个月内消退，且完全集中在东部DFC区域，原因是恒河平原缺乏配套工业基础设施。
AI.research_question: 印度专用货运走廊（DFC）对当地经济活动的因果效应是什么？这种效应在不同区域是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 大型货运铁路基础设施投资能否产生本地经济溢出效应，尤其是在缺乏配套工业基础设施的落后地区，这一问题缺乏严格的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施对本地经济发展的溢出效应理论；短期扰动效应（disruption effect）与长期增长效应的权衡；配套基础设施（互补性投资）的重要性。
AI.method: 利用交错开通（staggered commissioning）的自然实验设计；月度夜间卫星灯光数据（568个印度区，87个月）；双向固定效应模型；Callaway-Sant'Anna校正；安慰剂检验；异质性分析（东/西DFC）。
AI.findings: DFC开通导致当地经济活动平均下降4.5%（β=-0.046, p=0.004），该短期扰动效应在6-12个月内消退；异质性分析显示效应完全集中在东部DFC区域（β=-0.067, p=0.006），西部DFC无显著效应；原因在于恒河平原缺乏配套工业基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供货运铁路基础设施对本地经济影响的区级因果证据；揭示了在缺乏配套工业设施的情况下，货运铁路单独建设可能产生短期负面扰动而非正面溢出；丰富了基础设施与发展经济学中关于"互补性投资"的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他发展中国家的大型交通基础设施投资提供政策启示：单纯建设货运铁路不足以推动落后地区经济增长，需配合工业园区建设、最后一公里连接等配套投资。

title: The Ontological Boundary of Algorithmic Assessment: AI, Heidegger, and the Irreducibility of Identity in Executive Search

detail.title: The Ontological Boundary of Algorithmic Assessment: AI, Heidegger, and the Irreducibility of Identity in Executive Search

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Alessio Montaruli, is the Founder and Group CEO of KiTalent, an international executive search firm referenced throughout the paper as the applied context in which the philosophical argument becomes operational. KiTalent's published methodology, editorial work, and engagement models are cited as primary evidence for the practical implications of the argument. The author received no external funding for this research. The paper develops a philosophical position that is methodologically and commercially aligned with KiTalent's service model, and this alignment is disclosed throughout the paper itself.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper presents a philosophical and conceptual argument; it does not involve human or animal subjects, clinical data, or empirical research requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used in recruitment and executive search to map markets, classify profiles, screen documents, organize signals, and accelerate data-intensive workflows. These uses are valuable. They increase visibility into candidate markets and can make the early phases of search more systematic. Yet the same representational power creates a category risk: organizations may begin to confuse candidate representation with candidate understanding. This paper develops a Heideggerian account of that boundary. Drawing on Heidegger's concepts of being-in-the-world, significance, care, publicness, idle talk, enframing, standing-reserve, and releasement, it argues that artificial intelligence operates most effectively on the level of already-public, already-formalized, and already-circulating intelligibility. It can map the visible field of talent, but it cannot perform the singularizing judgment required to assess identity-fit in a concrete executive mandate. The argument provides a philosophical grounding for the capability-identity distinction developed in KiTalent's research and methodology: soft skills belong to capability, while culture fit belongs to identity and must be read in relation to a specific organizational world. The paper also explains how this framework supports a set of KiTalent practices: AI can legitimately support talent mapping but should not replace consultant-led interviews; blind CVs are weak evidence in senior search; and Proof-First Search de-risks executive hiring by shifting proof from decontextualized representation to situated evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文基于海德格尔哲学，论证了人工智能在人才招聘中只能处理已公共化、已形式化的表征层面，无法理解候选人的"身份契合"，由此划定了AI能力与人类判断的边界，并支持了KiTalent的方法论实践。
AI.research_question: 在AI越来越多地用于人才招聘和猎头搜索的背景下，组织如何区分"候选人表征"与"候选人理解"？AI的能力边界在哪里？
AI.motivation: AI在招聘中的表征能力日益强大，但这种能力同时产生了"类别风险"：组织可能混淆对候选人的表征与对候选人的真正理解，从而在高级人才选拔中做出错误判断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 海德格尔的"在世存在"、"意蕴"、"操心"、"公共性"、"闲言"、"座架"、"持存资源"、"释然"等概念。
AI.method: 哲学概念分析（概念演绎与理论建构），结合KiTalent的实际方法论进行应用推导。
AI.findings: AI只能有效处理已经公共化、形式化、流通中的"可理解性"，即映射可见的人才市场；但AI无法执行识别"身份契合"所需的特殊化判断，因为身份契合必须相对于具体的组织世界来理解。能力与身份之间存在根本性区分：软技能属于能力范畴，文化契合属于身份范畴。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"能力-身份"区分提供了海德格尔式的哲学基础，将AI的能力边界从功能层面提升到存在论层面，深化了对招聘中技术与人性边界的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持了KiTalent的三项实践：AI可合法用于人才地图但不应替代顾问主导的面试；盲选简历在高级别招聘中证据力弱；"证明优先搜索"通过将证据从去情境化的表征转向情境化的证据来降低高管招聘风险。

title: Detecting Deposit Stress in Real Time: Rate Shock and Early Warning Model Performance
affiliations: University of North Florida

detail.title: Detecting Deposit Stress in Real Time: Rate Shock and Early Warning Model Performance
detail.abstract: This study asks whether supervisory CAMELS-based early warning systems can detect stress in real time when a new shock operates through unfamiliar mechanisms. We examine this question using the 2022-2025 rate shock as the empirical setting. Drawing on 1,001,495 bank-quarters of U.S. commercial bank data from 1992 to 2025, we compare three progressively richer specifications under a rolling expanding-window design across 13 out-of-sample quarters. Two modifications recover meaningful detection capacity: depositor composition augmentation dominates early in the episode before crisis observations accumulate, while regime conditioning gains advantage as coefficient shifts become identifiable. The depositor-composition model identifies 34 additional stressed institutions over the pooled benchmark, with hit rates reaching 55.9 percent against a 5.6 percent baseline. Overall, the results show that standard CAMELS architecture can be augmented to recover meaningful supervisory signals in real time, using data already available to supervisors.

AI.tldr: 本研究表明，基于CAMELS的监管预警系统在面对陌生机制的新冲击时，通过加入存款人构成信息和制度条件调整，可以在实时中有效识别银行压力。
AI.research_question: 当新的冲击通过不熟悉的机制运作时，基于CAMELS的监管预警系统能否实时检测到银行压力？
AI.motivation: 2022-2025年利率冲击通过陌生机制（如存款人挤兑）引发银行危机，传统CAMELS模型可能失效，需要检验其是否仍能实时检测压力。
AI.theoretical_framework: CAMELS评级框架、早期预警系统、存款人构成理论、制度条件调整（regime conditioning）、滚动扩展窗口预测方法。
AI.method: 使用1992-2025年1,001,495个银行-季度观测值，采用滚动扩展窗口设计，在13个样本外季度中比较三种逐步丰富的模型规格（基准模型、存款人构成增强模型、制度条件调整模型）。
AI.findings: 存款人构成增强在危机初期（危机观测值累积前）主导检测能力，制度条件调整在系数转移可识别后展现优势。存款人构成模型比基准模型多识别34家压力机构，命中率达55.9%（基准为5.6%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了标准CAMELS架构可通过增强手段在新型冲击下恢复实时监管信号，拓展了早期预警系统在非传统危机情景下的适用性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了利用已有数据（存款人构成）增强预警能力的可行方案，无需等待危机观测值累积即可在危机初期识别压力机构。

title: Implementing UNSCR 2250 in West Africa: A Critical Policy Analysis of Liberia’s National Action Plan on Youth, Peace, and Security (2025–2030)

detail.title: Implementing UNSCR 2250 in West Africa: A Critical Policy Analysis of Liberia’s National Action Plan on Youth, Peace, and Security (2025–2030)
detail.abstract: This study analyzes the Liberia National Action Plan on Youth, Peace and Security (2025-2030) to evaluate its effectiveness in the localized implementation of United Nations Security Council Resolution (UNSCR) 2250. Focus is placed on how the policy addresses the critical pillars of rehabilitation, mental health, and reintegration for young people in post-conflict Liberia. Adopting a qualitative policy analysis approach, the study evaluates the framework through the lenses of peacebuilding theory, youth participation theory, and policy implementation theory. The findings indicate that while the policy marks a significant stride in institutionalizing youth civic engagement, severe gaps remain regarding operational funding, concrete implementation coordination, and robust psychosocial support networks. The paper concludes with actionable recommendations to strengthen West African youth security policies, serving as a blueprint for implementing global mandates in fragile, post-conflict environments.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了利比里亚《青年、和平与安全国家行动计划（2025-2030）》，评估其在地方层面落实联合国安理会第2250号决议的有效性，重点关注战后青年康复、心理健康和重返社会三大支柱。研究发现该政策在制度化青年公民参与方面取得进展，但在运营资金、实施协调和心理支持网络方面存在严重不足。
AI.research_question: 利比里亚《青年、和平与安全国家行动计划（2025-2030）》在地方落实联合国安理会第2250号决议方面是否有效？该政策如何解决战后青年康复、心理健康和重返社会问题？
AI.motivation: 利比里亚作为后冲突国家，青年在战后重建中面临康复、心理健康和重返社会的严峻挑战，而全球青年、和平与安全议程在地方层面的实际落地效果尚不明确，需要系统性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 和平建设理论、青年参与理论、政策执行理论
AI.method: 定性政策分析方法
AI.findings: 政策在制度化青年公民参与方面取得显著进展，但在运营资金、具体实施协调和健全的心理社会支持网络方面存在严重缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将和平建设理论、青年参与理论和政策执行理论整合应用于后冲突国家青年政策的评估框架，丰富了全球青年、和平与安全议程在地方层面的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可操作的政策建议以加强西非青年安全政策，为脆弱后冲突环境中落实全球青年安全议程提供了参考蓝本。

title: Multi-Objective Optimization of Double-H Finned Tube Heat Exchangers via CFD-DEM: Entropy Generation, Fouling, and Erosion Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU) and Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU)

detail.title: Multi-Objective Optimization of Double-H Finned Tube Heat Exchangers via CFD-DEM: Entropy Generation, Fouling, and Erosion Analysis
detail.abstract: H-type finned tube heat exchangers are widely used in heat transfer process of dusty gas. Problems such as flow resistance, fouling and erosion are multiple constraints restricting the design of such heat exchangers. This study establishes a multi-objective optimization framework combining RSM, entropy weight method and NSGA-Ⅱ algorithm, and adopts the CFD-DEM coupled method to simulate a double H-type finned tube heat exchanger, aiming to balance its thermodynamic efficiency, erosion resistance and anti-deposition performance under gas-solid two-phase flow. Firstly, a quadratic polynomial response surface model was developed to quantitatively correlate five key parameters (tube spacing, fin width, fin fillet radius, gas velocity, particle diameter) with three critical performance indicators, namely total entropy generation (ΔSpro), erosion rate (verosion), and deposition rate (Rd). The effects of parameter coupling on entropy generation, fouling and erosion were analyzed in further detail, revealing clear trade-offs and synergistic effects between the parameters. The Pareto solution obtained via NSGA-II resulted in an optimized design that reduced total entropy generation from 0.005957 W/K to 0.005815 W/K, and the erosion rate from 45.28×10⁻¹² m/s to 37.76×10⁻¹² m/s, but the deposition rate increased from 13.14% to 15.05%. The comprehensive performance of the heat exchanger has been improved. This work provides an effective optimization method for the design of tube heat exchangers in gas-solid two-phase flow conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了结合RSM、熵权法和NSGA-Ⅱ算法的多目标优化框架，通过CFD-DEM耦合方法模拟双H型翅片管换热器，在气固两相流条件下平衡其热力学效率、抗侵蚀和抗沉积性能，获得了优化设计方案。
AI.research_question: 如何在气固两相流条件下，通过多目标优化方法平衡H型翅片管换热器的热力学效率、抗侵蚀性能和抗沉积性能？
AI.motivation: H型翅片管换热器在含尘气体换热中应用广泛，但存在流动阻力、积灰和冲蚀等多重约束问题，需要一种有效的优化方法来平衡这些相互冲突的性能指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: RSM（响应面法）、熵权法、NSGA-Ⅱ算法、CFD-DEM耦合方法
AI.method: 采用CFD-DEM耦合方法进行数值模拟，建立二次多项式响应面模型关联五个关键参数与三个性能指标，利用NSGA-Ⅱ算法求解Pareto最优解。
AI.findings: 优化后总熵产从0.005957 W/K降至0.005815 W/K，侵蚀率从45.28×10⁻¹² m/s降至37.76×10⁻¹² m/s，但沉积率从13.14%升至15.05%，综合性能得到提升。参数之间存在明显的权衡与协同效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将RSM、熵权法与NSGA-Ⅱ算法相结合，构建了针对气固两相流换热器的多目标优化框架，揭示了参数耦合对熵产、积灰和冲蚀的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为含尘气体条件下翅片管换热器的工程设计提供了有效的多目标优化方法，有助于在热效率、抗侵蚀和抗沉积之间取得平衡。

title: Pre-feasibility Study on Business Opportunities for Women in a Changing Energy Value Chain in West Africa
affiliations: Maalexi Inc.

detail.title: Pre-feasibility Study on Business Opportunities for Women in a Changing Energy Value Chain in West Africa
detail.abstract:
This report culminates an effort to identify, evaluate, and evolve recommendations for improving women entrepreneurs across West Africa. It forms part of the ECREEE project — Pre-feasibility Study on Business Opportunities for Women in a Changing Energy Value Chain — funded by the NEPAD-IPPF, a multi-donor Special Fund hosted by the African Development Bank.

The project's mission is to ensure West Africa meets its goal of universal energy access for over 300 million people — by developing a gender-responsive regional energy market strategy that harnesses the entrepreneurial capacity of ECOWAS women to establish energy businesses and deploy energy technologies for the region's largely unserved population. It targets 16 women-led businesses across 4 ECOWAS countries, focusing on underfinanced SMEs, and is a direct product of the ECOWAS Policy for Gender Mainstreaming in Energy Access — targeting 25% women's participation in private sector energy by 2020 and 50% by 2030.

Challenges for women in West Africa span operational complexity, technological expertise, labour, and financial management — compounded by cultural pressures and limited technical know-how. Addressing these urgently is essential for women entrepreneurs to thrive in the evolving energy value chain.

Key Achievements

a) Created the first-ever formal database of women entrepreneurs in the energy value chain across West Africa's four largest economies.

b) Built a comprehensive understanding of women-led businesses across operational, commercial, technological, labour, legal, and financial dimensions.

c) Identified key challenges and developed tactical and strategic solutions to address them.

d) Collected primary field research data to support future women's entrepreneurship policy development.

e) Identified feasibility studies as replicable templates for regional expansion and diversification.

f) Equipped banks and funds with financial and operational profiles of women-led businesses to better design fit-for-purpose products.

g) Provided multilateral agencies and governments a framework for mainstreaming women in the fast-changing energy value chain.

h) Delivered actionable insights to women entrepreneurs on performance, improvements, and new growth opportunities.

i) United women entrepreneurs and ecosystem stakeholders to collaborate and collectively drive business growth.

AI.tldr: 本报告旨在识别、评估并提出改善西非女性企业家状况的建议，是ECREEE项目的一部分，致力于通过开发性别响应型区域能源市场战略，帮助西非实现全民能源可及目标，并赋能女性主导的能源企业发展。
AI.research_question: 如何识别并改善西非女性企业家在能源价值链中面临的挑战，以促进她们在区域能源市场中的参与和发展？
AI.motivation: 西非有超过3亿人口缺乏能源服务，而女性企业家在能源价值链中面临运营复杂性、技术能力、劳动力和财务管理等多重挑战，亟需制定性别响应型战略以释放女性创业潜力，推动区域能源可及目标实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别主流化理论、创业生态系统理论、能源价值链分析框架
AI.method: 实地调研（覆盖西非四大经济体的16家女性领导企业）、数据库构建、多维分析（运营、商业、技术、劳动、法律、财务维度）、可行性研究模板化
AI.findings: 1）建立了西非首个女性能源企业家正式数据库；2）全面掌握了女性领导企业在运营、商业、技术、劳动、法律和财务等多维度的特征；3）识别出关键挑战并制定了战术和战略解决方案；4）为金融机构提供了女性企业画像以设计适配产品；5）为多边机构和政府提供了将女性纳入能源价值链的框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 为性别主流化理论在能源领域的应用提供了实证支持；丰富了创业生态系统理论在欠发达地区和女性创业情境下的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了将女性纳入能源价值链的实践框架；2）为金融机构提供了女性企业画像以开发定制化金融产品；3）为女性企业家提供了绩效改进和增长机会的行动洞察；4）建立了可复制的可行性研究模板，便于区域扩展；5）促进了女性企业家与生态系统利益相关方的协作。

title: Corporate Criminal Liability and Firm Value
affiliations: Northwestern University - Pritzker School of Law

detail.title: Corporate Criminal Liability and Firm Value

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming, Journal of Law, Economics, and Organization

detail.abstract: This paper explores the impact of corporate criminal law doctrine on firm value. I study stock market reactions to an Indian Supreme Court decision holding that a corporation’s mens rea (i.e., criminally culpable state of mind) is established when its controller has criminal intent. Companies controlled by individuals and families declined in value in response to this decision, likely because they had human controllers—dominant individuals or families—whose misconduct now left the firms vulnerable to prosecution. This value destruction is concentrated in business group companies, which are tightly controlled by founding families and whose reputation is linked to that of their controller. The effect is smaller for firms that have more foreign institutional ownership, and larger for consumer-facing firms. Firms with individual and family controllers relatively increased legal spending after the decision. Criminal liability’s effect on firm value is thus influenced by the identity of controllers, and institutional investors seem to be better ex-ante monitors of misconduct than consumers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度最高法院关于企业法人犯罪意图（mens rea）的判决如何影响公司价值。研究发现，由个人或家族控制的企业在该判决后市值下跌，尤其集中在企业集团和面向消费者的公司中；境外机构持股多的公司受影响较小，这些公司事后增加了法律支出。结论是：刑事责任对企业价值的影响取决于控制者身份，机构投资者是比消费者更有效的事前不当行为监督者。
AI.research_question: 企业刑事法人原则（企业法人的犯罪意图由其控制者的犯罪意图所确立）如何影响公司价值？
AI.motivation: 企业刑事责任是公司治理中的重要法律问题，但鲜有研究实证检验企业刑事法人原则如何通过控制者身份影响企业价值。印度最高法院的这一判决提供了一个外生冲击，可以识别因果关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业刑事责任理论、公司治理中的控制权结构理论、信号传递理论、代理理论
AI.method: 事件研究法（Event Study），利用印度最高法院判决这一外生冲击，分析股票市场异常回报率；并使用横截面回归分析异质性效应。
AI.findings: 1）个人和家族控制企业市值在判决后显著下跌；2）企业集团和面向消费者的公司下跌更严重；3）境外机构持股比例高的公司受影响较小；4）受影响公司在判决后增加了法律支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证揭示企业刑事法人原则通过控制者身份影响企业价值的机制；丰富了企业刑事责任与公司治理交叉领域的理论研究；区分了机构投资者与消费者在企业监督中的不同角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者和立法者设计企业刑事责任制度提供实证依据；提示投资者（尤其是机构投资者）在企业治理和合规监督中的重要作用；为企业（尤其是家族控制企业）的风险管理和合规策略提供参考。

title: The perfect district heating modelling approach in energy system models: insights from an expert survey
affiliations: Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research ISI, , Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research ISI and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The perfect district heating modelling approach in energy system models: insights from an expert survey
detail.abstract: District heating (DH) networks based on renewable and excess heat sources are set to play a key role in the transition to a climate-neutral energy system. Model-based assessments analyse the role of DH in terms of demand, infrastructure, supply, costs, and the impact on the energy system. Various approaches are employed, ranging from simulation and optimisation of individual DH networks to large-scale energy system models (ESM) that consider multi-sector interdependencies, e.g. heat-electricity interactions via power-to-heat. While there are reviews of various aspects of ESM and of specific DH models, there is still a lack of insight into how DH is modelled in ESM that capture sector coupling across several regions, the EU or worldwide. This paper addresses this gap by investigating the modelling of DH in 13 large-scale, multi-sector ESM. The results demonstrate that some ESM model DH with a single grid per country, while others use several grids per model region. Additionally, the level of techno-economic detail varies: Some ESM cover over 16 DH generation technologies, others cover less than eight technologies. The DH demand is often given as an exogenous input parameter, whereas some ESM model it endogenously. While all models have distinct advantages, they also have shortcomings, indicating that there is room for improvement in modelling techniques to better capture the complexity of DH in large-scale, multi-sector ESM.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了13个大型多部门能源系统模型（ESM）中区域供热（DH）的建模方式，发现模型在网格划分、技术细节、需求内生性等方面存在显著差异，指出当前建模技术仍有改进空间。
AI.research_question: 大型多部门能源系统模型（ESM）是如何对区域供热（DH）进行建模的？不同模型在DH建模上有哪些差异和不足？
AI.motivation: 区域供热网络在气候中和能源转型中至关重要，但现有综述多聚焦于特定DH模型或ESM的某一方面，缺乏对跨区域、跨部门的大型ESM中DH建模方式的系统性认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源系统建模理论、部门耦合理论（如热电耦合）、区域供热网络建模方法。
AI.method: 对13个大型多部门能源系统模型（ESM）中区域供热（DH）的建模进行系统比较分析，涵盖网格划分、技术细节、需求建模等维度。
AI.findings: （1）部分模型每个国家仅设一个DH网格，部分模型每个区域设多个网格；（2）技术细节差异大：有的模型涵盖16种以上DH发电技术，有的不到8种；（3）DH需求多为外生输入参数，部分模型内生建模；（4）各模型各有优势但也存在不足，整体建模技术有待改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了大型多部门ESM中DH建模的系统性综述空白，揭示了当前建模方法在空间分辨率、技术细节、需求建模等方面的多样性与局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源系统建模者提供了DH建模现状的全面图景，指出了未来改进方向，有助于更准确地评估DH在能源转型中的作用。

title: Technical Sustainability in Software Systems: An Empirically Grounded Research Agenda from the Brazilian Context
affiliations: State University of Maringá, State University of Maringá, affiliation not provided to SSRN, State University of Maringá, University of Castilla-La Mancha, State University of Maringá and State University of Maringá

detail.title: Technical Sustainability in Software Systems: An Empirically Grounded Research Agenda from the Brazilian Context
detail.abstract: Technical sustainability (TS) of Software Systems (SS) refers to the capacity of software systems to endure and evolve over time by preserving high internal quality. While it connects present-day decisions with long-term viability, little is known about how software practitioners understand and apply it within the Brazilian context. This study investigates perceptions, practices, and barriers associated with TS through a survey of 222 software practitioners, combining quantitative and qualitative analyses to derive a research agenda for advancing TS. The findings reveal high perceived importance and normative appreciation of the technical pillars of TS, but limited institutionalization and predominantly reactive adoption. Practices tied to short-term delivery cycles are prioritized, whereas activities essential for long-term evolutionary sustainment remain secondary and are frequently interrupted, even when recognized as important. This misalignment reflects sociotechnical tensions: TS requires continuity and incremental evolution, while organizations tend to operate under short cycles driven by immediate goals. Consequently, short-term prioritization emerges as a rational response to production constraints rather than negligence or lack of awareness. The main contribution of this study is a research agenda, grounded in practitioners' reported experiences, oriented toward understanding the organizational capabilities and governance mechanisms required to sustain TS over time. Although derived from the Brazilian context, this agenda addresses broader tensions that may also inform future research in other software development settings.​

AI.tldr: 本研究通过调查222名巴西软件从业者，发现尽管他们高度认可技术可持续性（TS）的重要性，但在实践中却呈现出低制度化、被动应对、短周期优先的特征，揭示了短期交付与长期可持续之间的社会技术张力，并据此提出未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 软件从业者在巴西语境下如何理解技术可持续性（TS）？他们在实践中如何应用TS？面临哪些障碍？
AI.motivation: 技术可持续性（TS）对软件系统的长期生存和演化至关重要，但关于从业者如何理解并将其应用于实践（尤其在巴西语境下）的认知十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术可持续性（Technical Sustainability）理论；社会技术系统理论（sociotechnical tensions）。
AI.method: 对222名软件从业者进行问卷调查，结合定量和定性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 从业者对TS技术支柱的感知重要性和规范性评价很高。2. 但TS的制度化水平低，采用方式主要为被动反应型。3. 短期交付周期的实践被优先执行，而长期演化可持续性的关键活动被边缘化或频繁中断。4. 短期优先是对生产约束的理性反应，而非忽视或缺乏意识。5. 存在显著的社会技术张力：TS需要连续性和增量演化，但组织以短期目标驱动运作。
AI.theory_contributions: 基于从业者经验提出研究议程，聚焦于理解支撑TS长期所需的组织能力和治理机制；揭示了短期优先并非无知，而是理性应对生产约束的社会技术现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西及类似语境下的软件组织提供了识别和弥合短期与长期可持续性之间差距的实证依据；为实践者推动TS制度化提供方向参考。

title: Governance of Therapeutic Uncertainty Across Expedited Regulatory Systems: Comparative Lifecycle Governance Architectures, Institutional Legitimacy, and Reform Pathways in Contemporary Pharmaceutical Regulation

detail.title: Governance of Therapeutic Uncertainty Across Expedited Regulatory Systems: Comparative Lifecycle Governance Architectures, Institutional Legitimacy, and Reform Pathways in Contemporary Pharmaceutical Regulation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, professional, or personal relationships that could be perceived as influencing the work reported in this manuscript. No conflicts of interest exist with respect to the authorship, publication, or interpretation of the findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on a systematic literature review and analysis of publicly available regulatory documents, academic publications, and policy reports. It did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data; therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no specific funding from agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted independently without external financial support.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This research did not include any clinical trials or human subject participation.

keywords: Global Lifecycle Governance Architecture Expedited approval

detail.abstract: Expedited regulatory pathways have transformed contemporary pharmaceutical governance by enabling earlier patient access to therapies addressing serious, rare, or life-threatening conditions. Although these mechanisms, including accelerated approval, conditional marketing authorization, adaptive licensing, reliance pathways, and real-world evidence integration, have expanded therapeutic access and innovation incentives, they have simultaneously intensified regulatory dependence on surrogate endpoints, incomplete clinical datasets, and evolving post-market evidentiary obligations. This review examines expedited approval systems through a comparative lifecycle governance framework, analysing how major regulatory authorities, including the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), European Medicines Agency (EMA), Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA), Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), and Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA), operationalise therapeutic uncertainty across the medicine lifecycle. The manuscript argues that expedited pathways should not be understood solely as accelerated approval mechanisms, but rather as institutional governance architectures that redistribute evidentiary uncertainty from pre-market evaluation toward post-market oversight, enforcement, and lifecycle accountability. Through comparative analysis of conditional approvals, reliance systems, pharmacovigilance infrastructures, confirmatory trial enforcement, and regulatory modernisation initiatives, the review identifies substantial divergence in lifecycle governance capacity across jurisdictions. The paper further develops the concept of a Governance Failure Spectrum, illustrating how insufficient post-market oversight may progressively result in enforcement drift, institutional fragility, legitimacy erosion, and declining public trust. To address these challenges, the manuscript proposes a Global Lifecycle Governance Architecture (GLGA) integrating proportional oversight, evidentiary modernisation, reliance-sensitive governance, real-world evidence ecosystems, pharmacovigilance strengthening, artificial intelligence oversight, and international convergence strategies. The review additionally introduces an Expedited Regulatory Legitimacy Doctrine (ERLD), emphasising that the long-term legitimacy of expedited systems depends not on approval speed alone but on sustained lifecycle accountability, institutional transparency, adaptive evidence generation, and the preservation of public trust. By synthesizing regulatory science, governance theory, pharmacovigilance, artificial intelligence governance, and comparative institutional analysis, this manuscript reframes expedited approval systems as dynamic lifecycle governance ecosystems rather than isolated procedural acceleration tools. The proposed framework offers a governance-oriented foundation for future regulatory modernisation and international convergence in increasingly data-intensive and uncertainty-driven pharmaceutical environments.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了美国FDA、欧盟EMA、日本PMDA、印度CDSCO和英国MHRA等主要监管机构的加速审批路径，提出加速审批应被视为一种在全生命周期中重新分配不确定性的治理架构，而非单纯的加速机制。文章构建了"治理失败谱系"概念，并提出了"全球生命周期治理架构"和"加速监管合法性原则"两大框架。
AI.research_question: 不同司法管辖区的加速审批路径如何在药品全生命周期中运作？这些路径如何重新分配监管不确定性？以及如何构建可持续的全球生命周期治理架构？
AI.motivation: 加速审批路径虽然扩大了治疗可及性和创新激励，但同时也加剧了对替代终点、不完整临床数据集和不断变化的市场后证据义务的依赖，导致监管不确定性增加。现有研究多将加速审批视为程序性加速工具，缺乏从全生命周期治理视角的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期治理理论、监管治理理论、治理失败谱系概念、加速监管合法性原则
AI.method: 比较分析：对FDA、EMA、PMDA、CDSCO、MHRA五大监管机构的加速审批、有条件批准、依赖路径、药物警戒基础设施、确证性试验执行和监管现代化举措进行系统比较。
AI.findings: 1) 不同司法管辖区在生命周期治理能力上存在显著差异；2) 市场后监管不足可能导致"治理失败谱系"——从执行漂移到制度脆弱性、合法性侵蚀，再到公众信任下降；3) 加速审批的本质是监管不确定性的重新分配，将证据不确定性从上市前评估转移至市场后监管。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 重新理论化了加速审批路径，将其从程序性加速工具重新定义为动态生命周期治理生态系统；2) 提出了"治理失败谱系"概念，阐明了市场后监管不足的递进性后果；3) 构建了全球生命周期治理架构和加速监管合法性原则，为监管科学提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构提供了全球生命周期治理架构，包含比例监管、证据现代化、依赖敏感治理、真实世界证据生态系统、药物警戒强化、人工智能监管和国际趋同策略；2) 强调加速系统的长期合法性取决于持续的生命周期问责制、制度透明度、适应性证据生成和公众信任的维护；3) 为数据密集型和不确定性驱动的制药环境下的监管现代化和国际趋同提供了以治理为导向的基础。

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地指出，所谓的"税收政策"实际上反映的是政府选择保护谁和惩罚谁的政治决策，并以H.R.40（奴隶制赔偿法案）被连续阻挠35年与政府短时间内为政治盟友设立巨额基金（17.76亿美元）的对比作为例证。
AI.research_question: 税收政策在多大程度上反映了政府基于政治偏好的分配决策，而非纯粹的经济或财政考量？
AI.motivation: 揭示税收政策背后隐藏的政治选择与不平等，批判政府利用财政工具优先服务政治盟友，同时忽视历史不公的补偿（如奴隶制赔偿）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性政策分析、分配正义理论、种族批判理论
AI.method: 比较案例分析（对比H.R.40的立法僵局与政治盟友基金的快速设立）
AI.findings: 政府能够在72小时内为政治盟友创立17.76亿美元的基金，但H.R.40（奴隶制赔偿法案）已被连续阻挠35年，表明税收与财政政策实质上是政治权力分配的工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了税收政策"中性"和"技术性"的传统认知，揭示了政策制定中的种族与政治权力维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁公众和政策制定者重新审视财政政策的正义性，推动对系统性种族不公（如奴隶制赔偿）的政策回应。

title: The Welfare State Matrix: An Architectural Diagnosis of the German Welfare State

detail.title: The Welfare State Matrix: An Architectural Diagnosis of the German Welfare State

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is himself active, as Managing Director of KyberMedis GmbH (Berlin), in the field of municipal care architecture, in particular in the planning and support of medical care centres and primary-care centres in municipal sponsorship. The architectural diagnosis developed in this paper thus touches a field of application in which the author is at the same time operationally active as a consultant. The analytical argument of the paper is conceived independently of this; it takes no side for any specific form of sponsorship and makes the conflict of interest expressly transparent here for reasons of scholarly transparency.

detail.abstract:
Over the past three decades, the German welfare state has undergone more reforms than in the five decades before — and in the process has not stabilised but destabilised. This paper advances the thesis that the structural cause of recurrent reform crises lies not primarily in demography, scarcity of funding or a shortage of skilled personnel, but in the systematic conflation of four welfare-state logics: Insurance (collective, contribution-based), Social Assistance (individual, tax-based), Public Provision (collective, tax-based, territorially anchored) and Market (individual, premium-based).

The Welfare State Matrix develops an analytical diagnostic model — not an empirical causal model. Methodologically it follows the construction of ideal types in the Weberian sense (Weber, 1922) and makes visible where the effect of welfare-state reform is systematically absorbed by structural logic breaks. The analysis shows that exemplary fields of reform — the contribution-based health-insurance cover of recipients of Germany’s means-tested minimum income support system (Bürgergeld), the capacity funding of hospitals, the interface between statutory and private health insurance, and the structures of primary care — display a consistent pathology: at each of these points incompatible logics meet without the conflation having been resolved in architectural terms. In the case of the primary-care centre this pathology appears in especially concentrated form — here all four logics converge at the level of a single care institution. Reform efforts fail less because of an absence of political will than because of this unresolved structural conflation.

International reference systems show that architectural clarification is not only practically feasible but leads to structurally more stable and demonstrably more capable care systems: the Netherlands, with the separation — established since 2006 — of the Zorgverzekeringswet, the Wet langdurige zorg and the Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning, whose reformed system held leading positions in international performance comparisons for years; and the Swedish system, with its regional tax funding. The paper proposes a Welfare State Architecture Act on the model of regulatory framework legislation, a parallel restructuring of the Social Code (Sozialgesetzbuch) along the four logics, and a step-by-step clarification strategy directed at the most costly logic breaks. The Welfare State Matrix makes this architectural clarification possible; it is not itself a reform programme but supplies the hitherto unstated precondition for the success of any such programme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出德国福利国家危机根源在于保险、社会救助、公共供给和市场四种逻辑的系统性混淆（"逻辑断裂"），并构建"福利国家矩阵"作为诊断模型，主张通过立法和法典重组实现逻辑厘清。
AI.research_question: 德国福利国家反复出现改革危机的结构性原因是什么？如何通过逻辑厘清来稳定福利体系？
AI.motivation: 过去三十年德国福利改革比之前五十年还多，但系统不仅未稳定反而更不稳定；现有解释（人口、资金、人力短缺）不足，需从结构性逻辑混淆角度重新诊断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 韦伯式理想类型建构法；四种福利国家逻辑：保险（集体、缴费型）、社会救助（个人、税收型）、公共供给（集体、税收型、地域性）、市场（个人、保费型）。
AI.method: 理想类型分析法（韦伯，1922），构建"福利国家矩阵"作为分析诊断模型（非实证因果模型），选取四个典型改革领域进行病理分析。
AI.findings: 四个改革领域（最低收入保障者的缴费型医保覆盖、医院能力资助、法定与私人医保接口、初级保健结构）均呈现"逻辑断裂"病理；初级保健中心是四种逻辑汇聚的极端案例；国际比较（荷兰2006年改革、瑞典区域税收体系）表明逻辑厘清可行且有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"福利国家矩阵"诊断模型，将改革失败归因于结构性逻辑混淆而非政治意愿不足，为福利国家比较研究提供新的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议制定《福利国家架构法》、按四种逻辑重组《社会法典》、分步厘清成本最高的逻辑断裂点，为德国及类似国家福利改革提供操作性路径。
