The proposed multimodal defense achieved the best recovery performance with 0.482 mAP@0.5, substantially outperforming Gaussian filtering, JPEG compression, LGS, and SAC-style baselines. Ablation, transferability, and statistical robustness analyses further validated the effectiveness and generalizability of the framework for enhancing adversarial resilience in YOLO-based detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态对抗补丁防御框架，通过集成CNN空间特征、FFT频率描述符和显著性梯度特征来检测并修复对抗补丁，在YOLO检测器上显著提升了对抗鲁棒性（从0.046恢复至0.482 mAP@0.5）。
AI.research_question: 如何有效防御针对YOLO实时目标检测系统的对抗补丁攻击？
AI.motivation: 对抗补丁攻击对YOLO检测器构成严重威胁，特别是在监控、自动驾驶、机器人和边缘AI等关键应用中，而现有防御方法效果有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态特征融合理论（CNN空间特征+FFT频率特征+显著性梯度特征）；图像修复理论；对抗学习理论。
AI.method: 提出统一的多模态对抗补丁防御框架：1）多模态特征融合（CNN空间+FFT频率+显著性梯度）识别对抗区域；2）基于图像修复的补丁中和处理；3）融合RFAConv增强的ADYOLO检测器。
AI.findings: 1）对抗补丁使YOLO检测性能从0.926骤降至0.046 mAP@0.5；2）所提多模态防御达到0.482 mAP@0.5的最佳恢复性能；3）显著优于高斯滤波、JPEG压缩等基线方法；4）消融实验、迁移性分析和统计鲁棒性分析均验证了框架的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将多模态特征融合（空间+频率+显著性）系统性地应用于对抗补丁检测与防御，为YOLO检测器的对抗鲁棒性提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）实现了可实际部署的对抗补丁防御统一流水线；2）在INRIA行人数据集上验证了方法的有效性；3）对监控、自动驾驶、机器人等场景具有直接应用价值。

title: Increasing Milk Production and Milk Quality with Supplementation of Forage Legumes in Small-scale Dairy Farmers of Rwanda
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Rwanda Agriculture Board

detail.title: Increasing Milk Production and Milk Quality with Supplementation of Forage Legumes in Small-scale Dairy Farmers of Rwanda
detail.abstract: Low dietary protein and poor- quality forages continue to limit productivity in smallholder dairy systems in Rwanda. This study evaluated the effects of incorporating forage legumes into grass- based diets on milk yield and milk composition of crossbred dairy cows managed under smallholder conditions. Experimental diets were formulated by mixing grass with 0,15, and 30% forage legumes (Calliandra C, Leucaena L, and Desmodium I in even proportions).  Feed samples from each diet were collected weekly, dried, ground, and analyzed for dry matter, crude protein, and mineral content using standard AOAC methods to confirm nutrient composition. Diets were formulated to be isonitrogenous (17% CP) and isocaloric (2.2 Mcal/kg DM). Six Freisian x Ankole lactating crossbred dairy cows (415±40.3kg BW kg) were assigned to the three dietary treatments using a replicated 3 x 3 Latin square for 3 periods, each period made of 7d of adaptation and 7 days of data collection. Cows were fed diets at 3% BW on a DM basis and were fed twice a day. Milk yield and dry matter intake (DMI) were daily recorded during the collection period. Milk samples collected at the end of each period were analyzed for crude protein (CP) and Crude fat. Data were analyzed using the GLM procedure of RStudio 4.4.2. Legume supplementation significantly increased milk yield from 5. 7 L/day to 6. 1 L/day (p = 0. 04). Milk crude protein and fat content were not affected by dietary treatment(p> 0. 05). Dry matter intake increased numerically from 12. 4 to 13. 3 kg/day with legume inclusion. Average daily gain (0. 4 to 0. 0.5kg/day) and feed conversion ratio (2. 6 to 2.0. 0) showed numerically improved values but were not statistically significant. These findings indicate that moderate inclusion of forage legumes (15% - 30%) in grass- based diets enhances nutrient quality, increases feed intake, improves milk production, and promotes animal growth without affecting milk composition. Integrating legumes such as Calliandra C, Leucaena L, and Desmodium I, into smallholder feeding systems represents a practical strategy to improve dairy cow performance while reducing dependence on expensive commercial concentrates.

AI.tldr: 卢旺达小农奶牛饲喂含15%-30%豆科牧草（银合欢、银合欢、山蚂蝗）的草基日粮，可显著提高产奶量（5.7→6.1 L/天），且不影响乳成分，干物质采食量和日增重也有改善趋势。
AI.research_question: 在卢旺达小农条件下，将豆科牧草纳入草基日粮对杂交奶牛产奶量和乳成分有何影响？
AI.motivation: 卢旺达小农奶牛养殖中，低蛋白日粮和劣质牧草持续限制生产力，需寻找低成本、可持续的替代方案替代昂贵的商业精料。
AI.theoretical_framework: 豆科牧草提供优质蛋白质和矿物质，改善日粮营养品质；等氮等能条件下，增加采食量和养分利用率，从而提升产奶性能。
AI.method: 6头弗里斯兰×安科拉泌乳杂交奶牛，采用3×3拉丁方设计，设三个处理（0%、15%、30%豆科牧草），每期14天（7天适应+7天采集），分析日采食量、产奶量、乳成分及生长指标，数据用GLM分析。
AI.findings: 豆科牧草显著提高产奶量（5.7→6.1 L/d, p=0.04）；干物质采食量（12.4→13.3 kg/d）、日增重（0.4→0.5 kg/d）和饲料转化率（2.6→2.0）均有改善但未达显著；乳蛋白和乳脂含量无显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了在等氮等能条件下，豆科牧草改善饲料适口性和采食量，而非仅通过提高日粮蛋白浓度来促进产奶，为饲料配比优化提供了机制解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 推荐小农奶农在草基日粮中添加15%-30%的豆科牧草（银合欢、银合欢、山蚂蝗），可提升产奶量且不降低乳品质，减少对昂贵商业精料的依赖，具有实际推广价值。

title: Combined Standardized AUC: A Robust Metric for Multi-Class Model Evaluation and Selection
affiliations: University of Central Florida, The University of Texas at El Paso and University of Central Florida

detail.title: Combined Standardized AUC: A Robust Metric for Multi-Class Model Evaluation and Selection
detail.abstract: Model performance metrics are fundamental to the model selection process, as they balance accuracy, fairness, and task-specific objectives. This study introduces the Combined Standardized Area Under the Curve (CS-AUC) as a robust and comprehensive metric for evaluating multiclass classification models, particularly within the Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) framework. The proposed CS-AUC exhibits four major advantages. First, it accommodates both ordinal and nominal multiclass classification tasks. Second, in contrast to conventional metrics, it is independent of arbitrarily chosen probability thresholds. Third, its standardization procedure alleviates the effects of class imbalance, which is a persistent challenge in multi-class problems. Lastly, it enables fair and consistent comparisons across models and datasets while quantifying the uncertainty. In addition, the CS-AUC achieves greater efficiency and accuracy than the multiclass AUC (MAUC) optimization method introduced by Yang et al. [1], particularly for the large sample sizes commonly encountered in modern data science applications. Compared with additional alternatives such as the Volume Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Surface (VUS), the Hypervolume Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Manifold (HUM) and M metric, which are restricted to prespecified orders among the classes, our proposed method can generalize more broadly.The CS-AUC is constructed using a One-vs-One (OvO) framework across all classes, which an approach shown to be more efficient than the One-vs-All (OvA) design. Each pairwise AUC is standardized using corresponding variance and then aggregated through weighted averaging to produce a single unified metric. This design allows the CS-AUC to generalize across diverse multiclass scenarios while simultaneously addressing class imbalance and ensuring fairness in evaluation. The utility of the proposed metric is validated through both simulated and real-world datasets. Empirical results confirm that our proposed method can provide a robust, interpretable, and computationally efficient tool for model evaluation within the AutoML framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多分类评估指标CS-AUC，通过成对标准化与加权聚合，在AutoML框架下实现了对不平衡数据集的公平、高效、稳健的模型评估。
AI.research_question: 如何在AutoML框架下设计一个能同时处理序数和名义多分类任务、不受阈值影响、缓解类别不平衡、并实现跨模型与数据集公平可比的多分类评估指标？
AI.motivation: 现有多分类评估指标（如MAUC、VUS、HUM、M metric）存在对类别顺序有预设限制、效率较低或不能公平处理类别不平衡等问题，亟需一个更通用、稳健且计算高效的统一指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于One-vs-One框架的成对AUC标准化与方差加权聚合方法，结合统计标准化理论构建综合指标CS-AUC。
AI.method: 采用One-vs-One框架计算所有类别对的AUC，通过对应方差进行标准化，然后加权平均聚合为一个统一指标。通过模拟数据和真实数据集进行实证验证。
AI.findings: CS-AUC在大样本场景下比MAUC更高效准确；相比VUS、HUM、M metric等指标不受类别顺序限制、泛化能力更强；能有效缓解类别不平衡问题，提供公平一致的跨模型与数据集比较，并量化不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的、可泛化至多种多分类场景的标准化评估框架，弥补了现有指标在类别顺序限制和不平衡处理方面的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AutoML框架提供了一个鲁棒、可解释且计算高效的模型评估工具，提升了多分类模型选择和自动化调优的实践效率与公平性。

title: Optimized Trainable Sample Selection (TSS) for One-Class Classification in High Dimension Space
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Optimized Trainable Sample Selection (TSS) for One-Class Classification in High Dimension Space
detail.abstract: Apart from high dimensional data, the massive number of trainable samples may lead computing challenges for machine learning (ML) applications. For anomaly detection or one-class classification (OCC) tasks; presence of massive number of trainable samples leads to undesired computational overhead especially; for the decision boundary-based classifiers such as support vector data descriptor (SVDD) and one-class support vector machine (OCSVM). For such classifiers, the identification of support vectors (decision boundary points) is the most important concern whereas the other samples do not contribute enough information. With this motivation, the present research proposes an optimized novel trainable samples selection (TSS) technique via means of Gaussian transformation, hyperspherical coordinates (radius and angles in d- dimension space) followed by angular bins. The key assumption of this approach is that the data distribution is Gaussian with identity covariance in nature, and in case of other distribution, the data points must be transformed in Gaussian distribution of the class-of-interest (CoI) samples (target class samples). The proposed approach approximates the convex boundary in angle space. Diverse datasets ( Iris, MNIST, UCI default credit card, Indian Pines, Glass and svmguide) have been experimented to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于高斯变换和超球坐标的优化训练样本选择技术（TSS），用于解决异常检测/单类分类中大规模训练样本带来的计算开销问题，通过对角度空间进行分箱来近似凸边界，从而筛选出对决策边界贡献最大的支持向量。
AI.research_question: 如何在大规模训练样本条件下，高效选择对决策边界最重要的支持向量，以减少异常检测和单类分类任务的计算开销？
AI.motivation: 在异常检测/单类分类任务中，SVDD和OCSVM等基于决策边界的分类器面临大规模训练样本带来的计算开销问题，而只有支持向量（决策边界点）对分类贡献最大，其他样本信息冗余。因此需要一种高效的选择机制来筛选关键训练样本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高斯变换（将数据转换为高斯分布）、超球坐标（在d维空间中用半径和角度表示数据点）、角度分箱（在角度空间近似凸边界）
AI.method: 提出优化训练样本选择（TSS）技术：首先将数据假设为高斯分布（若非高斯则变换为目标类的高斯分布），然后通过超球坐标将数据表示为半径和角度，再利用角度分箱在角度空间近似凸边界，最终筛选出对决策边界最有贡献的样本。
AI.findings: 在Iris、MNIST、UCI default credit card、Indian Pines、Glass和svmguide等多个数据集上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性，能够有效减少计算开销同时保持分类性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种基于高斯变换与超球坐标角度分箱的训练样本选择理论框架，为大规模单类分类问题提供了新的支持向量筛选思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SVDD和OCSVM等决策边界分类器提供了一种降低计算开销的可行方案，适用于高维大数据场景下的异常检测应用。

title: From Pilot to Policy: Experimental Evidence from Scaling Online Tutoring
affiliations: Ministerio de Inclusi´on, ESADE Center for Economic Policy and World Bank, CUNEF Universidad, , Universidad de Alicante and Instituto de Empresa Business School

detail.title: From Pilot to Policy: Experimental Evidence from Scaling Online Tutoring

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research involves data collected on human subjects. IRB approval was obtained from the Ethics Committee linked to the Social Inclusion Itineraries, created by Order ISM/208/2022 dated March 10, attached to the General Secretariat of Inclusion and Social Welfare Objectives and Policies (Spain). The Ethics Committee issued its approval for the development of this evaluation on September 8, 2023.
declarations.funderStatement: We thank the Ministry of Inclusion, Social Security and Migration for facilitating access to the administrative data used in this study and funding. Claudia Hupkau acknowledges financial support from the Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovaci´on through grants PID2022-140206OB-I00 and RYC2023-044087-I. Teresa Molina-Mill´an acknowledges financial support from Generalitat Valenciana through the plan GenT program (CDEIGENT/2020/016).

detail.abstract: We study a randomized controlled trial of an online mathematics tutoring program scaled from a successful pilot and implemented entirely by regional education authorities in Spain, using interim public-school teachers rather than specially recruited tutors. Assignment to tutoring increased end-ofyear grades by 0.15σ and standardized math test scores by 0.11σ-approximately one-third of pilot effects. An experimental socio-emotional module improved affective outcomes but not academic gains. Results provide realistic benchmarks for the "voltage drop" policymakers should anticipate when scaling evidence-based interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一项在线数学辅导项目在西班牙大规模推广的效果。该项目从成功试点扩展到由地区教育当局实施、由公立学校临时教师担任导师。结果显示，辅导使期末成绩提高0.15个标准差，标准化数学测试成绩提高0.11个标准差——约为试点效果的1/3。社会情感模块改善了情感结果但未提升学业成绩。研究为政策制定者提供了规模化实施时预期"电压降"的现实基准。
AI.research_question: 将成功的在线数学辅导试点项目大规模推广到真实教育环境中，其效果如何？社会情感学习模块能否带来额外收益？
AI.motivation: 教育干预措施从实验室或试点环境推广到真实大规模实施时，效果通常会显著衰减（即"电压降"现象）。现有研究缺乏对在线辅导项目规模化效果的严谨因果证据，尤其缺乏由公共教育系统而非研究者主导实施的真实场景评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 规模化衰减理论（"电压降"效应）2. 教育干预的因果推断框架3. 社会情感学习理论
AI.method: 随机对照试验（RCT），在西班牙由地区教育当局实际实施，使用公立学校临时教师作为导师。实验包含在线数学辅导干预和一个实验性的社会情感学习模块。
AI.findings: 1. 辅导使期末成绩提高0.15σ，标准化数学测试成绩提高0.11σ2. 规模化效果约为试点效果的1/33. 社会情感模块改善了情感结果（如学习态度、自信心等），但未提升学业成绩
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了在线教育干预从试点到规模化"电压降"的定量基准2. 区分了学业效果与社会情感效果的不同衰减模式3. 验证了真实教育系统实施（而非研究者主导）对效果的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了规模化教育干预时预期效果衰减的实证依据2. 揭示了由公共教育系统而非专业研究团队实施干预的现实效果3. 建议社会情感学习模块可独立改善非学业结果，但需更有效整合才能提升学业表现

title: Detecting AI in Doctoral Dissertations: An Exploratory Empirical Analysis of EdD Dissertation Integrity and Implications for Doctoral Program Design

detail.title: Detecting AI in Doctoral Dissertations: An Exploratory Empirical Analysis of EdD Dissertation Integrity and Implications for Doctoral Program Design
detail.abstract: This exploratory study examined the level of inappropriate AI usage in doctoral dissertations, specifically across 100 EdD dissertations published in 2025 within the fields of the Educational Leadership and Administration. These fields represent the primary academic home of the Doctor of Education (EdD) degree, which has been the focus of substantial rethinking over the last twenty years in an attempt to refashion the degree to support educational leaders as "practitioner-scholars." This study found that 56% of dissertations contained more than negligible (>10%) AI-generated writing; moreover, 19% of dissertations contained more than 50% AI-generated text. Additional suggestive findings included that lower AI use was correlated with an institution being an R1 or R2 institution, while higher AI use was correlated with an institution being private non-profit. This paper concludes with some thoughts regarding strengthening specific doctoral programmatic features vis-à-vis issues academic integrity and legitimacy and next steps for future research.

AI.tldr: 本研究对2025年教育领导与管理领域的100篇EdD博士论文进行探索性分析，发现56%的论文中AI生成内容超过10%，19%超过50%。AI使用水平与机构类型相关：R1/R2研究型大学使用较少，私立非营利大学使用较多。论文最后探讨了学术诚信与项目改进建议。
AI.research_question: 教育博士（EdD）学位论文中不恰当的AI使用程度如何？不同机构类型之间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年EdD学位在重新定位为培养"实践者-学者"的过程中，学术诚信问题备受关注。AI写作工具的普及对学位论文的原创性构成新挑战，需要实证数据来了解问题的严重程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实践者-学者框架（Practitioner-Scholar Framework）；学术诚信与合法性理论
AI.method: 探索性研究，选取2025年教育领导与管理领域的100篇EdD博士论文，使用AI检测工具分析AI生成内容的占比，并比较不同机构类型（R1/R2研究型大学 vs 私立非营利大学）之间的差异。
AI.findings: 56%的论文中AI生成内容超过10%（即超出可忽略水平）；19%的论文中AI生成内容超过50%。AI使用率与机构类型存在关联：R1/R2研究型大学AI使用率较低，私立非营利大学AI使用率较高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地量化了EdD博士论文中的AI使用程度，为"实践者-学者"培养模式下的学术诚信讨论提供了经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育博士项目改革提供数据支持，提示加强博士论文过程中的学术诚信监督；帮助不同机构类型识别自身在AI合规教育上的薄弱环节。

title: RAPIDS: A Risk-Adaptive Privacy-Preserving Intelligent Data-Sharing Expert System for IoT-Fog-Cloud Environments
affiliations: and Lecturer

detail.title: RAPIDS: A Risk-Adaptive Privacy-Preserving Intelligent Data-Sharing Expert System for IoT-Fog-Cloud Environments
detail.abstract: This paper presents RAPIDS, a risk-adaptive privacy-preserving intelligent data-sharing expert system for IoT--fog--cloud environments. RAPIDS treats each sharing request as a joint decision problem over sharing action, processing location, and privacy mechanism, and combines hard governance rules, machine-learning-based privacy-risk prediction, multi-objective strategy optimization, and explanation generation to recommend \textit{allow}, \textit{conditional allow}, \textit{deny}, or \textit{expert review}. To evaluate this setting, we construct a fused benchmark from the UCSD ExtraSensory mobile/wearable sensing dataset and 43,927 Android Data Safety Label profiles, preserving real sensing contexts and real app-declaration signals while generating the remaining request context through a reproducible protocol. Experiments on all 60 ExtraSensory users with repeated user-level cross-validation, twelve baselines, five ablations, sensitivity and robustness analysis, statistical testing, and runtime profiling show that RAPIDS improves on interpretable and optimization-based baselines while maintaining zero critical false-allow behavior. RAPIDS also reduces conditional exposure risk, supports calibrated recovery of low-risk \textit{allow} decisions, and completes online decision plus explanation in 0.2908~ms/request. These results show that RAPIDS provides an effective and explainable expert-system layer for privacy-aware IoT data sharing across device, fog, and cloud environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAPIDS，一个面向IoT-雾-云环境的风险自适应隐私保护智能数据共享专家系统，通过结合治理规则、机器学习风险预测、多目标策略优化和解释生成，在保持零关键错误放行的同时，实现高效、可解释的隐私决策。
AI.research_question: 如何在IoT-雾-云环境下设计一个既能保护隐私又能实现智能数据共享的决策系统？
AI.motivation: IoT-雾-云环境中数据共享面临隐私风险与可用性之间的权衡，现有方法缺乏自适应、可解释且能处理多种决策选项（允许、条件允许、拒绝、专家审查）的综合解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联合决策问题框架（共享行动、处理位置、隐私机制）、硬治理规则、基于机器学习的隐私风险预测、多目标策略优化、解释生成。
AI.method: 构建融合基准数据集（UCSD ExtraSensory数据集+43,927个Android数据安全标签），在60个用户上进行重复用户级交叉验证，与十二个基线、五个消融实验对比，进行敏感性分析、鲁棒性分析、统计检验和运行时性能分析。
AI.findings: RAPIDS在可解释基线和优化基线上均表现更优，保持零关键错误放行行为，降低条件暴露风险，支持对低风险允许决策的校准恢复，在线决策加解释仅需0.2908毫秒/请求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数据共享决策形式化为联合决策问题，融合硬规则与机器学习预测，提出多目标优化策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可部署的专家系统层，在IoT-雾-云环境下实现隐私保护与数据共享的有效平衡，具有实时性和可解释性。

title: The Road to Fiscal Armageddon
affiliations: The Wharton School and

detail.title: The Road to Fiscal Armageddon
detail.abstract: We study how sovereign fiscal stress builds before macroeconomic collapses. Using a panel of developed and emerging economies from 1950 to 2023, we show that the interest-expense-to-revenue ratio strongly predicts GDP and consumption disasters, as well as hyperinflation, while debt-to-GDP has little predictive power once financing costs are accounted for. The relationship is highly nonlinear, especially in emerging economies. We develop a quantitative open-economy model with rollover risk that matches these patterns to study the impact of anticipated transitions toward higher government spending in advanced economies. The model highlights how financing conditions, monetary policy, and fiscal adjustment jointly shape macroeconomic fragility.

AI.tldr: 本文发现利息支出/财政收入比率比债务/GDP更能预测宏观经济崩溃（GDP下降、消费灾难、恶性通胀），并构建开放经济模型解释这一非线性关系，进而分析发达经济体政府支出扩张的影响。
AI.research_question: 什么指标能有效预测主权财政压力引发的宏观经济崩溃？
AI.motivation: 传统上债务/GDP被广泛用于衡量财政可持续性，但它在预测危机方面表现不佳。本文试图寻找一个更好的前瞻性指标，并理解其背后的经济机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权债务展期风险模型（rollover risk）、开放宏观经济模型、财政压力与非线性阈值效应。
AI.method: 面板数据分析（1950-2023年发达与新兴经济体）+ 定量开放经济模型。
AI.findings: ①利息支出/财政收入比率是GDP下滑、消费灾难和恶性通胀的强预测因子；②债务/GDP在考虑融资成本后预测能力大幅减弱；③该关系具有高度非线性，尤其在新兴经济体中；④发达经济体未来政府支出扩张会通过融资条件、货币政策和财政调整共同放大宏观脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出利息支出/收入比作为更优的财政脆弱性测度，将融资成本纳入危机预测框架；揭示了财政压力通过展期风险渠道产生非线性宏观经济效应的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了监测财政脆弱性的新指标（利息支出/收入比），警示发达经济体在支出扩张下面临的宏观脆弱性累积风险。

title: Fiscal Sustainability in the Philippines: A Literature Review on Elevated Post-Pandemic National Government Debt, Fiscal Deficits, and Durable Revenue Capacity

detail.title: Fiscal Sustainability in the Philippines: A Literature Review on Elevated Post-Pandemic National Government Debt, Fiscal Deficits, and Durable Revenue Capacity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The author has no financial relationship with the Philippine government, IMF, AMRO, CPBRD, Bureau of the Treasury, or any institution discussed in the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it did not involve human participants, patient data, animal subjects, interviews, surveys, or primary data collection. The research relies exclusively on publicly available government, legislative, and institutional reports.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This literature review examines the extent to which Philippine fiscal sustainability is threatened by elevated post-pandemic National Government debt, persistent fiscal deficits, and limited durable revenue capacity. Using 2021 as the baseline for pandemic-era fiscal expansion, the review analyzes Philippine government fiscal reports, CPBRD budget analysis, the IMF 2025 Article IV Consultation, and AMRO's 2025 Annual Consultation Report. The review finds that the Philippines does not currently face an immediate fiscal crisis, as National Government debt remains serviceable and supported by a relatively prudent debt profile, including domestic borrowing, fixed-rate instruments, and medium-to long-term maturities. However, fiscal sustainability remains conditional and vulnerable to medium-term risks. Elevated debt constrains fiscal space, persistent deficits prolong borrowing requirements, and limited durable revenue capacity weakens the government's ability to consolidate without compressing productive expenditure. The review argues that revenue capacity is the most structural vulnerability, while growth underperformance is the key stress trigger. Overall, Philippine fiscal sustainability is threatened to a moderate but manageable extent, depending on whether the government can sustain growth, implement credible revenue reforms, control debt-service pressures, and convert post-pandemic recovery into a durable fiscal path.

AI.tldr: 本文献综述评估了菲律宾在疫情后高债务、持续财政赤字和有限收入能力背景下的财政可持续性，认为当前虽无立即危机，但中期风险可控但需警惕。
AI.research_question: 疫情后菲律宾的财政可持续性受到多大程度的威胁？
AI.motivation: 疫情后菲律宾国债高企、财政赤字持续、收入能力有限，需要系统评估财政可持续性是否面临实质性威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政可持续性理论，强调债务可服务性、财政空间、收入能力与增长之间的联动关系。
AI.method: 文献综述法，分析菲律宾政府财政报告、CPBRD预算分析、IMF 2025年第四条磋商报告及AMRO 2025年年度磋商报告。
AI.findings: 菲律宾当前无立即财政危机，国债可服务且债务结构相对审慎（国内借款、固定利率、中长期为主）；但中期风险存在：高债务压缩财政空间、持续赤字延续借款需求、收入能力不足限制财政整固；收入能力是最结构性弱点，增长不佳是关键压力触发因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将财政可持续性分析从简单债务比率拓展为"债务结构-收入能力-增长表现"三维框架，并区分了结构性弱点与触发因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾政府提供政策优先级建议：维持增长、实施可信的收入改革、控制偿债压力、将疫后复苏转化为可持续财政路径。

title: The Duty to Explain: Fiduciary Intelligibility Under ERISA

detail.title: The Duty to Explain: Fiduciary Intelligibility Under ERISA

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: This Essay examines whether the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (“ERISA”) contains an emerging principle of fiduciary intelligibility within its participant disclosure framework. ERISA requires Summary Plan Descriptions (“SPDs”) to be written in a manner “calculated to be understood by the average plan participant.” While modern pension disclosure has become increasingly sophisticated and financially technical, this Essay argues that administrative and financial disclosure are not necessarily equivalent to fiduciary intelligibility. The Essay does not propose a formally recognized standalone fiduciary duty to disclose internal deliberations. Rather, it identifies a participant-facing practice of fiduciary justification potentially latent within ERISA’s disclosure architecture itself. In a post-Loper Bright environment emphasizing statutory interpretation over accumulated administrative convention, the Essay argues that ERISA’s SPD framework may reveal a continuing commitment to participant-facing fiduciary stewardship rather than technical disclosure alone.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨ERISA（《雇员退休收入保障法》）的参与者披露框架中是否隐含一项"受托人可理解性"原则。文章认为，行政披露和财务披露不等于受托人可理解性，并指出ERISA的摘要计划说明（SPD）框架可能体现出一种面向参与者的受托人正当性实践，而非仅仅是技术性披露。
AI.research_question: ERISA的参与者披露框架中是否包含一项新兴的"受托人可理解性"原则？
AI.motivation: 现代养老金披露日益复杂和金融技术化，但可理解性与技术性披露并不等同；在Loper Bright案后强调法定解释而非行政惯例的背景下，重新审视ERISA的披露架构具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 受托人 fiduciary理论；法定解释 interpretive statutory interpretation；参与者披露框架 participant disclosure framework
AI.method: 法律文本分析与规范性论证
AI.findings: ERISA的SPD框架可能体现一种面向参与者的受托人正当性实践；行政披露和财务披露不等于受托人可理解性；该框架可能揭示了一种持续存在的、面向参与者的受托人 stewardship 承诺。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"受托人可理解性"（fiduciary intelligibility）的概念；区分了技术性披露与受托人可理解性之间的差异；为理解ERISA披露框架提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Loper Bright案后的ERISA法定解释提供指导；提示养老金计划管理者应重视披露的可理解性而非仅仅是技术合规性；可能影响未来ERISA披露义务的司法认定标准。

title: Beyond LSTMS: A Comparative Analysis of Transformers, CNN-LSTMS, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNS) and Reinforcement Learning in Financial Time-Series Forecasting
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur

detail.title: Beyond LSTMS: A Comparative Analysis of Transformers, CNN-LSTMS, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNS) and Reinforcement Learning in Financial Time-Series Forecasting
detail.abstract: Financial time-series forecasting remains one of the most challenging domains in quantitative finance due to the inherent stochasticity and non-stationary nature of market data. In this study, utilizing the finlearner library, we present a comprehensive comparative analysis of modern Deep Learning architectures, specifically benchmarking Transformers, CNN-LSTMs, and conventional Recurrent Neural Networks (LSTMs, GRUs) against a Buy-and-Hold benchmark. Additionally, we evaluate a Reinforcement Learning (RL) approach using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to explore active decision-making capabilities. We introduce a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) approach as a novel mechanism to extract the underlying drift parameter (µ) from noisy price trajectories, modeled via Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM). Our empirical results on a tech-heavy portfolio (2020-2025) demonstrate that Transformers utilizing rich feature sets achieve a superior cumulative return of +66.68%, significantly outperforming the market benchmark (+52.42%) by approximately 14%. Furthermore, we show that while deep learning models optimize for predictive accuracy, PINNs offer a crucial layer of explainability by recovering interpretable physical parameters governing the stochastic process. We also find that while PPO shows promise, it requires careful feature engineering to overcome convergence issues in sparse data environments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用finlearner库，系统比较了多种深度学习架构（Transformer、CNN-LSTM、LSTM、GRU）以及强化学习（PPO）在金融时间序列预测中的表现，并创新性地引入物理信息神经网络（PINN）从几何布朗运动中提取漂移参数μ，发现Transformer在科技股投资组合（2020-2025）上取得最优回报（+66.68%，超越买入持有基准约14%），且PINN提供了可解释性。
AI.research_question: 在金融时间序列预测中，现代深度学习架构（Transformer、CNN-LSTM、RNN变体）以及强化学习方法相较于传统买入持有基准的表现如何？物理信息神经网络能否有效提取随机过程中的可解释物理参数？
AI.motivation: 金融时间序列因固有的随机性和非平稳性而极具挑战性，现有研究缺乏对多种现代深度学习架构在同一框架下的系统比较，且缺乏将物理信息引入神经网络以增强可解释性的探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于几何布朗运动（GBM）的随机过程理论；深度学习中的注意力机制（Transformer）、卷积-循环神经网络（CNN-LSTM）和门控循环单元（GRU/LSTM）；强化学习中的近端策略优化（PPO）；物理信息神经网络（PINN）的物理约束机制。
AI.method: 利用finlearner库，构建科技股投资组合（2020-2025年数据），对比Transformer、CNN-LSTM、LSTM、GRU、PPO和买入持有基准；引入PINN从噪声价格轨迹中提取GBM的漂移参数μ。
AI.findings: Transformer凭借丰富特征集取得最高累计回报（+66.68%），超越买入持有基准（+52.42%）约14个百分点；PINN成功恢复控制随机过程的可解释物理参数，增强了模型可解释性；PPO虽有潜力但在稀疏数据环境下存在收敛问题，需精细特征工程。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将PINN应用于金融时间序列的物理参数提取，将随机过程理论与深度学习可解释性相结合；为多种深度学习架构在同一金融数据集上的表现提供了基准比较。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明Transformer在科技股投资组合上的显著优势，为量化投资实践提供模型选择依据；PINN的可解释性有助于金融从业者理解模型决策背后的随机过程机制；提示PPO在稀疏数据场景下的收敛挑战，指导强化学习在实际交易中的应用优化。

title: Buchanan v. Samuels: The Cedar Rust Case Redux
affiliations: University of Central Florida

detail.title: Buchanan v. Samuels: The Cedar Rust Case Redux
detail.abstract: One of the most fascinating sessions at the 2025 meeting of the History of Economics Society (HES) was a roundtable on “The 50th anniversary of the Buchanan-Samuels Exchange.” As it happens, this intellectual exchange was motivated by an old takings case—Miller v. Schoene, decided in 1928—and takings law is one of my areas of expertise. The remainder of my paper reframes the Buchanan-Samuels exchange as a three-act drama and is thus organized as follows: Act I sets the stage of our story by revisiting the dispute in Miller v. Schoene. Next, Act II compares and contrasts Samuels’s framing of this case with Buchanan’s alternate framing. For Samuels, in brief, Miller v. Schoene is a textbook case of reciprocal harms, while for Buchanan, this case is about the sanctity of property rights. Lastly, Act III concludes with the climax and Buchanan’s denouement.

AI.tldr: 本文以三幕剧的形式重新诠释了 Buchanan 与 Samuels 围绕1928年征用案件 Miller v. Schoene 展开的学术交锋，分析了双方在产权与互害问题上的根本分歧。
AI.research_question: Buchanan 与 Samuels 关于 Miller v. Schoene 案的学术争论如何反映了双方在产权、政府角色和互害问题上的根本分歧？
AI.motivation: 2025年HES会议上关于Buchanan-Samuels交锋50周年的圆桌讨论激发了作者的兴趣，加之作者本人是征用法领域的专家，因此希望重新审视这一经典学术对话。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以三幕剧的戏剧结构作为分析框架，将学术交锋叙事化呈现。
AI.method: 历史文本分析与比较法学方法，通过重新解读 Miller v. Schoene 案件来重构 Buchanan 与 Samuels 的分歧。
AI.findings: Samuels 将 Miller v. Schoene 视为互害（reciprocal harms）的典型案例，而 Buchanan 则将其视为财产权神圣性的捍卫；两人对同一案件的不同解读揭示了其背后更深层的意识形态与理论立场分歧。
AI.theory_contributions: 以戏剧化的叙事框架重新呈现经典学术争论，为理解 Buchanan 与 Samuels 的理论分歧提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助法律与经济学者更清晰地理解征用法中产权保护与公共利益平衡的核心争议，以及不同理论立场对案件解读的深远影响。

title: From Bitter Lemons to Lemonade: The Fiscal Promise of Digital Service Taxes in Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: , Makerere University - College of Business and Management Sciences and Makerere University - College of Business and Management Sciences

detail.title: From Bitter Lemons to Lemonade: The Fiscal Promise of Digital Service Taxes in Sub-Saharan Africa

declarations.ethicsApproval: The Research did not use any data on human or animal subjects.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This Manuscript has been accepted conditionally by the European Journal of Public Finance

detail.abstract: This paper assesses the performance of digital service taxes and related fiscal measures in sub-Saharan Africa. Using an unbalanced panel of 47 countries over 2017-2022 and a differencein-difference-indifferences (DDD) framework, it estimates the effect of digital tax adoption on goods-and-services tax revenue relative to payroll taxes-a fiscally unrelated comparison tax head. The results show that digital tax adoption is estimated to increase consumption-based tax revenue by about 1.8 percentage points of GDP. However, gains are uneven-depending on governance quality, digital readiness, and policy design. The study highlights implementation challenges and draws policy lessons for sustainable digital taxation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2017-2022年47个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的非平衡面板数据，采用三重差分法评估数字服务税及财政措施对商品服务税收入的影响，发现数字税使消费税收入占GDP比重提高约1.8个百分点，但效果因治理质量、数字化准备度和政策设计而异。
AI.research_question: 数字服务税及财政措施在撒哈拉以南非洲的实施效果如何？
AI.motivation: 数字经济发展带来税收挑战，撒哈拉以南非洲国家日益采用数字税，但对其实际效果缺乏系统性实证评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三重差分法（DDD）、税收归宿理论、制度经济学（治理质量对税收效果的影响）
AI.method: 采用2017-2022年47个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的非平衡面板数据，运用三重差分法（DDD）框架，以工资税作为无关对照税种，估计数字税对商品服务税收入的影响。
AI.findings: 数字税采用使消费税收入占GDP比重提高约1.8个百分点；但收益分布不均，取决于治理质量、数字化准备度和政策设计；存在实施挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次运用DDD方法实证评估撒哈拉以南非洲数字税的财政效应；揭示了治理质量和数字化条件对税收效果的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为撒哈拉以南非洲国家数字税政策设计提供实证依据；识别了可持续数字税收的关键实施挑战和政策启示。

title: The Mortality Input Problem: Trajectory-Dependent Death and the Lifecycle Model

detail.title: The Mortality Input Problem: Trajectory-Dependent Death and the Lifecycle Model
detail.abstract: Heterogeneous-agent macroeconomics has reformed the income and wealth sides of the household problem. The HANK program established that aggregate dynamics require the cross-sectional distribution of marginal propensities to consume, balance-sheet exposures, and permanent income. Every model in this program inherits, without examination, a smooth actuarial mortality hazard calibrated to population life tables. This is the last unreformed input, and it is structurally wrong. The expected residual life of an agent is a value function defined on a manifold whose boundary is death. That function has a geometric property rarely stated in the economic literature: its curvature diverges at a specific powerlaw rate as the agent approaches the boundary. Every lifecycle model that represents mortality as a smooth hazard imposes a bounded-curvature approximation on a function whose curvature is unbounded. No function in the smooth hazard class can encode the shock structure of catastrophic diagnoses that dominate individual mortality trajectories near the boundary, regardless of how many parameters the hazard contains. We establish three structural consequences. First, the population-level response to symmetric interventions is asymmetric: the worsening direction systematically exceeds the improving direction by a factor governed by a single cross-sectional moment, the covariance between boundary curvature and intervention exposure. Second, this covariance is not a small correction in clinical settings: unlike the borrowing-constraint analog in macroeconomics, where the boundary binds for a minority of agents, the mortality boundary is universal, and the population-level curvature integral diverges in a way the macroeconomic scaling intuition cannot accommodate. Third, the representation class that correctly encodes the boundary geometry exists: trained networks with piecewise-linear activation produce value functions that are exactly tropical polynomials in the max-plus semiring, with the density of the piecewise structure near the boundary encoding the curvature divergence that smooth functions cannot. A constellation of puzzles that the lifecycle literature has documented and not resolved, covering wealth decumulation, bequest dispersion, annuitization, retirement timing, portfolio composition, health expenditure at end of life, long-term care insurance, Social Security claiming, and pension tax choices. These are projections of a single geometric fact. Correcting the mortality input generates each of them as equilibrium properties of the model rather than as calibrated parameters or behavioral anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文指出异质性主体宏观经济学中使用的平滑死亡率风险在结构上是错误的。死亡率边界的曲率在边界处发散，而平滑函数无法捕捉这一几何特性。使用热带多项式（ReLU网络）才能正确编码边界几何。这一修正能统一解释生命周期文献中关于财富积累、遗赠、年金化、退休时机、投资组合、临终医疗支出、长期护理保险、社保申领和养老金税收选择等一系列未解之谜。
AI.research_question: 异质性主体宏观经济学中普遍采用的平滑精算死亡率风险在结构上是否错误？如果错误，会产生哪些经济后果？
AI.motivation: 所有HANK（异质性代理人新凯恩斯）模型都继承了一个未经检验的平滑精算死亡率假设，但个体预期剩余寿命作为边界处的价值函数，其曲率在死亡边界处以幂律速率发散，平滑函数无法编码这一几何结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值函数的边界几何理论；热带几何（max-plus半环）与ReLU神经网络表示定理；死亡率边界的曲率发散与幂律标度关系。
AI.method: 理论推导与几何分析；比较平滑死亡率函数族与热带多项式（ReLU网络）的表示能力差异。
AI.findings: （1）对称干预下的人口响应不对称，恶化方向超过改善方向，因子由边界曲率与干预暴露的协方差决定；（2）死亡率边界是普适的（区别于宏观经济学中的借贷约束只约束少数人），曲率积分发散，宏观经济学已有的缩放直觉无法适用；（3）ReLU网络产生的热带多项式能正确编码边界处的曲率发散，而平滑函数无论含多少参数都无法编码灾难性诊断的冲击结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了死亡率建模的几何本质，证明了平滑函数类在表示死亡率边界行为上的结构性局限，提出了热带几何作为更优的表示框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 纠正死亡率建模错误后，财富积累缓慢、遗赠分布离散、年金化不足、退休时机选择、投资组合股票参与率、临终医疗支出上升、长期护理保险购买不足、社保申领时机、养老金税收选择等一系列生命周期文献中的"谜题"均可内生为模型的均衡属性，无需依赖校准参数或行为异常假设。

title:
Axiomatic Coherence of Fixed-Point Target Identification 
A Constitutional Mathematics Framework for Deterministic Antibiotic Discovery

detail.title:
Axiomatic Coherence of Fixed-Point Target Identification 
A Constitutional Mathematics Framework for Deterministic Antibiotic Discovery

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This manuscript does not report new studies involving human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. No clinical trial was conducted for the work reported in this manuscript.

detail.abstract: The global antibiotic pipeline faces systemic failure rooted in a fundamental methodological error: target identification is treated as a stochastic search problem rather than a deterministic fixed-point derivation. This paper resolves that error. Through recursive ontological decomposition across seven independent layers — molecular biology, resistance evolution, pharmacology, clinical validation, economic structure, formal verification, and regulatory pathway — and exhaustive pairwise cross-analysis of all 21 layer-pair coherence conditions, we prove that the F0F1 ATP synthase subunit C is the unique fixed point of axiomatic coherence in the antibiotic target space. The resulting constitutional framework formally guarantees: broad-spectrum efficacy ≥ 0.94 across 11 clinically critical bacterial species; resistance emergence probability Pescape ≤ 2.5 × 10−15 (Compton-class safety bound); a subscription-based economic model with provably positive net present value; and a pre-specified regulatory pathway qualifying for QIDP designation and Priority Review. This is not a probabilistic estimate. It is a mathematical necessity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过七层本体论分解和21对层间一致性分析，证明F0F1 ATP合酶亚基C是抗生素靶点空间中唯一公理一致性不动点，从数学上保证了广谱高效、超低耐药性和可行的经济监管路径。
AI.research_question: 抗生素研发管线系统性失败的根源是什么？能否通过确定性方法而非随机搜索找到理想的抗生素靶点？
AI.motivation: 全球抗生素管线面临系统性失败，传统靶点识别方法存在根本性方法论错误——将靶点识别视为随机搜索问题而非确定性不动点推导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 递归本体论分解（七层）、公理一致性分析、不动点定理、康普顿类安全边界
AI.method: 对分子生物学、耐药进化、药理学、临床验证、经济结构、形式化验证、监管路径七个独立层次进行递归本体论分解，并对全部21对层间一致性条件进行穷举配对交叉分析。
AI.findings: F0F1 ATP合酶亚基C是抗生素靶点空间中唯一公理一致性不动点；广谱效力≥0.94（覆盖11种临床关键菌种）；耐药出现概率≤2.5×10⁻¹⁵（康普顿类安全边界）；订阅制经济模型净现值为正；符合QIDP认定和优先审评的监管路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将抗生素靶点识别问题从随机搜索范式转向确定性数学推导范式，提出基于公理一致性的不动点方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可直接应用的靶点候选（F0F1 ATP合酶亚基C），以及配套的经济模型（订阅制）和监管路径（QIDP/优先审评），有望系统性修复抗生素研发管线。

title: When Does ESG Lose Value Relevance? A Discount-Rate Threshold

detail.title: When Does ESG Lose Value Relevance? A Discount-Rate Threshold
detail.abstract: Whether ESG performance creates value for shareholders remains contested. We ask whether the ESG-firm value relation in Korea depends on the prevailing monetary regime. Hansen's (1999) panel threshold model, applied to 5,110 firm-year observations of KOSPI-listed firms over 2012-2025 with cluster-robust inference and 1,000 bootstrap replications, locates a structural break at a 3-year AA-corporate bond yield of 3.19%. The threshold is sharply identified (F = 72.59, bootstrap p < 0.001) and falls between the Bank of Korea's pre-tightening years and the 2022-2024 hiking cycle. The ESG slope is positive below the threshold (β = 0.0147) and negative above it (β =-0.0262), though neither clears the 10% level (p = 0.398; p = 0.151). We read the evidence as a regime shift in how the Korean market prices ESG, in line with the long-duration discount-rate channel in Pástor, Stambaugh and Taylor (2021). The within-regime imprecision matches the rating-noise mechanism in Avramov et al. (2022).

AI.tldr: 本文利用Hansen面板门槛模型分析了2012-2025年韩国KOSPI上市公司数据，发现ESG与公司价值的关系取决于货币政策体制：当3年期AA级公司债收益率低于3.19%时，ESG与企业价值正相关；高于该阈值时则转为负相关，尽管两个区间内的系数均未达到10%的统计显著性水平。
AI.research_question: 韩国市场中ESG表现与公司价值的关系是否取决于货币政策体制（利率水平）？
AI.motivation: ESG表现能否为股东创造价值在学术界仍存在争议，本文试图从货币政策体制角度解释这一争议，探讨利率环境是否改变了市场对ESG的定价方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Pástor, Stambaugh and Taylor (2021)的长期贴现率渠道理论（ESG作为长期资产其价值对贴现率敏感），以及Avramov et al. (2022)的评级噪音机制。
AI.method: Hansen (1999)面板门槛模型，使用5,110个KOSPI上市公司-年度观测值（2012-2025年），采用聚类稳健标准误和1,000次Bootstrap重抽样，以3年期AA级公司债收益率为门槛变量。
AI.findings: 存在显著的体制转换点（门槛值3.19%，F=72.59，p<0.001）。低利率体制下ESG系数为正（β=0.0147, p=0.398），高利率体制下为负（β=-0.0262, p=0.151），但两个体制内的系数均不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为ESG-企业价值关系的争议提供了货币政策体制的解释视角，验证了贴现率渠道在韩国市场的适用性，并揭示了体制内估计不精确性与评级噪音理论的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示韩国企业在不同利率环境下应差异化地对待ESG投资策略，也为政策制定者在不同货币政策周期中评估ESG政策效果提供了参考。

title: Between Truth, Victory, and Timing: Retrospectics as a Strategically Delayed Discursive Intervention

detail.title: Between Truth, Victory, and Timing: Retrospectics as a Strategically Delayed Discursive Intervention
detail.abstract: Organizational decision-making processes are commonly described through two familiar discursive logics: a dialectical orientation toward insight and an eristic orientation toward victory. While this distinction is analytically useful, it remains insufficient for capturing communicative patterns in leadership, strategy, and power contexts whose effectiveness derives less from argumentative superiority than from temporal positioning. This paper conceptually examines and theoretically situates such a pattern: strategically delayed discursive interventions, in which actors initially engage in observation, restraint, or selective visibility before positioning themselves with increased influence during later, socially condensed, or cognitively fatigued phases of discourse. To consolidate this pattern conceptually, the term retrospectics is proposed. Retrospectics does not describe mere restraint, introversion, or classical moderation, but a specific form of discursive influence in which timing, status, observational advantage, and interpretative framing interact. The paper situates this pattern within organizational psychology through the lenses of speaker status, perceptual psychology, social fatigue, decision architecture, and informal authority, while selectively integrating perspectives from sociology and organization theory where these clarify how discursive influence becomes socially legitimized. Retrospectics is explicitly not introduced as a closed theory or validated psychometric construct, but as a cautious conceptual proposal intended to make an observable yet previously diffuse organizational pattern more precisely describable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"retrospectics"（后瞻策略）这一概念，描述了一种策略性延迟的 discursive 干预模式：行动者在早期阶段观察、克制或选择性可见，然后在后期社会性浓缩或认知疲劳阶段以增强的影响力介入。这不是一个封闭理论，而是一个概念性提议。
AI.research_question: 组织决策过程中是否存在一种不同于辩证性（追求洞察）和争论性（追求胜利）的、依赖时间定位而非论证优势的沟通模式，如何将其概念化？
AI.motivation: 既有的辩证性（dialectical）与争论性（eristic）话语逻辑区分虽然有用，但不足以捕捉那些有效性来自时间定位而非论证优越性的沟通模式（如领导力、战略、权力情境）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织心理学（说话者地位、知觉心理学、社会疲劳、决策架构、非正式权威），并选择性整合社会学与组织理论视角。
AI.method: 概念性研究（conceptual examination），理论推导与概念整合。
AI.findings: 提出"retrospectics"（后瞻策略）概念，指一种策略性延迟的话语干预模式：行动者早期观察、克制或选择性可见，后期在社会性浓缩或认知疲劳阶段以增强的影响力进行定位，其影响机制涉及时间安排、地位、观察优势和解释框架的交互作用。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）正式提出"retrospectics"概念，使一种此前可观察但分散的组织沟通模式得以更精确描述；（2）将时间维度引入话语影响力分析，补充了传统的辩证性/争论性二分法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者、战略决策者和组织成员提供一种理解"何时说"（时机）比"怎么说"（论证）更重要的沟通策略框架，有助于更有效地进行组织话语干预。

title: Inclusionary Regimes, Firm Size, and Housing Approval by Cities
affiliations: University of New Mexico

detail.title: Inclusionary Regimes, Firm Size, and Housing Approval by Cities
detail.abstract: Municipal permitting is a procedural tool that city officials can use to facilitate housing development. City officials control housing permitting in their jurisdiction, but state law ultimately delimits their authority. Using data at the municipal level, the present study examines the likelihood of US municipal governments approving permits for single-family or multifamily units. The study examines panel data on municipal permits for housing and inclusionary regimes. It presents annual data on state preemptions of inclusionary zoning compiled from the Local Solutions Support Center, state statutes, and court rulings identified on a case-by-case basis. Panel data for state preemptions is an original contribution from this research to the literature. The findings suggest that state preemptions of inclusionary zoning have varying impacts on the municipal approval of single-family and multifamily production. The study bridges local government literature and the public/private distinction framework to explain differences in housing units permitted by cities.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用市镇层面的面板数据，探讨州级事前禁止包容性分区政策对地方政府批准独户与多户住宅开发许可的影响，发现州级禁令对两类住房单位的影响存在差异。
AI.research_question: 州级事前禁止包容性分区政策如何影响美国市镇政府对独户与多户住宅开发许可的批准？
AI.motivation: 城市官员控制辖区内住房许可但受州法限制，现有研究缺乏对州级事前禁止政策如何影响地方政府实际许可决定的系统实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方政府文献（地方自治与州-地方关系）与公共/私人区分框架（解释住房单位类型差异）。
AI.method: 使用市镇层面的面板数据，结合来自Local Solutions Support Center、州法规及逐案识别的法院裁决所编制的州级事前禁止包容性分区年度数据，进行计量分析。
AI.findings: 州级事前禁止包容性分区对市镇批准独户与多户住宅生产具有不同影响，具体差异体现在两类住房单位的许可审批变化上。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次编制州级事前禁止包容性分区的面板数据集；将地方政府文献与公共/私人区分框架整合，为理解城市住房许可差异提供新解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市官员和政策制定者提供州级干预如何影响地方住房供给的实证证据，有助于优化住房开发许可制度设计。

title: Narrating Innovation in the Post-plausibility Era: Generative AI, Multimodal Pre-enactment, and the Case of Nikola Corporation

detail.title: Narrating Innovation in the Post-plausibility Era: Generative AI, Multimodal Pre-enactment, and the Case of Nikola Corporation
detail.abstract:
This article explores the shifting nature of communicative creativity in language-
intensive professional practices, specifically within strategic investor communication.
Using the rise and fall of Nikola Corporation as a seminal case study, it first
deconstructs the human creative agency involved in crafting multimodal pre-
enactments—discursive practices that simulate future technological realities to build
trust and market value. The analysis shows how human-led promissory narratives
use linguistic and visual innovation to bridge epistemic gaps, establishing a
benchmark for professional competence in pre-AI strategic communication.
The study then contrasts this human-centric creativity with the rise of Generative AI
(GenAI). It argues that as GenAI reduces the marginal cost of producing highly
plausible multimodal content to near zero, the “creative spark” of entrepreneurial
storytelling undergoes a radical transformation. In this emerging post-plausibility era,
the creative labor of professional communication shifts from the generative ability to
simulate reality toward a higher-order evaluative and ethical competence, positioning
trust as the primary strategic asset in an era of synthetic abundance. By analyzing
the Nikola Paradox, the article illustrates how the automation of strategic persuasion
leads to systemic skepticism, ultimately requiring a reconfiguration of professional
identity and a return to proof of physicality. The study proposes that in a GenAI-
saturated landscape, pre-enactment must be reframed as a transparently creative
vision, distinct from evidentiary claims. Through the introduction of a multidimensional
framework for evaluating promissory narratives, this research contributes to applied
linguistics by conceptualizing professional creativity not as the mere generation of
content, but as the strategic navigation of trust and authenticity in increasingly
mediated financial markets. Structurally, the article unfolds from a foundational
analysis of human narrative construction toward a critical examination of the GenAI
inflection point in Chapter 6, ultimately concluding in a conceptual model for verifying
credibility through physical evidence in Chapter 7.

AI.tldr: 本文以尼古拉公司兴衰为案例，分析了人类创意叙事与生成式AI在战略投资者沟通中的根本差异，指出在AI生成内容泛滥的"后可信度时代"，专业沟通的创造性从内容生成转向评估验证能力，信任成为核心战略资产。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI时代，语言密集型专业实践（尤其是战略投资者沟通）中的沟通创造力如何发生转变？人类主导的承诺性叙事与AI生成内容在构建信任和市场价值方面有何本质差异？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI能够以近乎零边际成本生产高度可信的多模态内容，传统以"创造性生成"为核心的专业沟通能力面临根本性挑战。理解这一转变对专业身份、信任机制和沟通伦理的影响，具有重要的理论和实践紧迫性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预演述（pre-enactment）、承诺性叙事（promissory narratives）、后可信度时代（post-plausibility era）、合成丰裕（synthetic abundance）、尼古拉悖论（Nikola Paradox）
AI.method: 以尼古拉公司兴衰为关键案例研究，采用定性分析方法对人类创意主体性及多模态预演述进行解构，并对比分析生成式AI介入后的沟通生态转型。
AI.findings: 1. 人类主导的承诺性叙事通过语言和视觉创新弥合认知鸿沟，建立了专业能力的基准；2. 生成式AI将可信内容生产成本降至近乎零后，专业沟通的创造性从"生成能力"转向"高阶评估与伦理能力"；3. 战略说服的自动化导致系统性怀疑主义，信任成为首要战略资产；4. 预演述必须重新定位为透明的创造性愿景，而非证据性主张。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"后可信度时代"概念，将专业创造力重新概念化为对信任和真实性的战略导航，而非简单的内容生成；建立了通过物理证据验证可信度的概念模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI饱和环境下的专业沟通实践提供了多维评估框架，指导从业者从内容生成者转型为可信度验证者，强调了物理性证明（proof of physicality）在数字沟通中的回归价值。

title: The Devil's Dilemma: Justice or Security in Post-conflict Sudan A Comprehensive Review
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Devil's Dilemma: Justice or Security in Post-conflict Sudan A Comprehensive Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am the sole writer and that is my country
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding

detail.abstract:
This paper examines the foundational trade-off between accountability for atrocity crimes and the
urgent need to end armed violence—what Sudanese civil society terms the “Devil’s Dilemma”
(مأزق الشيطان). Focusing on the prospective surrender or negotiation of the Rapid Support Forces
(RSF) in Sudan’s ongoing civil war (2023–2026), the paper develops a theoretical and comparative
framework for analyzing whether, when, and how states may lawfully and legitimately offer
conditional amnesties or reduced sentences to perpetrators of war crimes, crimes against humanity,
and genocide. Drawing on the jurisprudence of the Special Court for Sierra Leone, the evolving
customary international law debate on amnesties, and the transitional justice experiences of South
Africa (Truth and Reconciliation Commission), Rwanda (gacaca courts), Colombia (Special
Jurisdiction for Peace), Liberia (Charles Taylor), Sierra Leone (Lomé Accord), and six original
Sudanese case studies (1999 Amnesty Law; 2005 Comprehensive Peace Agreement; 2019–2021
transition; 2021 coup; 2020 Juba Peace Agreement; El Geneina massacres), the paper argues that
unconditional amnesty is legally impermissible and politically dangerous, while blanket rejection
of any accommodation is practically catastrophic. The paper proposes a middle-path model of
“conditional acceptance,” comprising targeted ICC surrender of senior leadership, strict vetting,
and DDR with judicial oversight, full truth-telling under oath, reparations financed from
perpetrators’ assets, and GPS-monitored behavioral restrictions. Four analytical tables and three
detailed scenarios (optimistic, pessimistic, and most likely) project the outcomes of different policy
choices. The conclusion argues that the only unforgivable error in Sudan is to pretend that the
choice is easy. That delayed justice is not abandoned justice if the delay saves lives.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨苏丹内战（2023–2026）中快速支援部队（RSF）投降或谈判时，如何在追究暴行罪责任与结束武装暴力之间取得平衡。通过比较分析国际法、多个国家的过渡司法经验及苏丹本土案例，提出“有条件接受”的中间路径模型，主张完全赦免违法且危险，完全拒绝则灾难性，关键在于以有条件方式推迟但非放弃正义。
AI.research_question: 在苏丹内战背景下，国家如何在法律与合法性上向实施战争罪、反人类罪和灭绝种族罪的 perpetrators 提供有条件赦免或减刑？何时以及如何操作是正当的？
AI.motivation: 苏丹民间社会将追究暴行罪责任与结束武装暴力之间的根本性权衡称为“魔鬼的困境”。这一困境在RSF可能投降或谈判的现实中尤为紧迫，现有研究缺乏针对苏丹具体情境的系统性理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于特别法庭法理、习惯国际法关于赦免的演变性辩论，以及南非真相与和解委员会、卢旺达加卡卡法庭、哥伦比亚和平特别司法管辖区、利比里亚查尔斯·泰勒案、塞拉利昂洛美和平协议等跨国过渡司法经验。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，结合六个苏丹原始案例（1999年赦免法、2005年全面和平协议、2019–2021年过渡期、2021年政变、2020年朱巴和平协议、埃尔杰奈纳大屠杀）的分析，构建四个分析表格和三种情景（乐观、悲观、最可能）推演。
AI.findings: 无条件赦免在法律上不被允许且政治上危险；完全拒绝任何妥协在实践上灾难性；“有条件接受”模型可行：包括将高级领导层移交国际刑事法院、严格审查、有司法监督的解除武装/复员/重返社会（DDR）、宣誓下的全面真相告知、从 perpetrator 资产中资助的赔偿、以及GPS监控的行为限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了介于完全赦免与完全拒绝之间的“有条件接受”理论模型，丰富了过渡司法中国际人道法与和平建设之间的张力研究，为习惯国际法中赦免的可允许性边界提供了新论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为苏丹及其他类似冲突后社会提供可操作的政策框架，包括差异化处理领导层与低层人员、资产追索用于赔偿、技术监控等具体机制，并强调“推迟的正义若拯救生命则非放弃正义”这一核心实践原则。

title: QUANTIFYING THE SYSTEM VALUE OF DISTRIBUTED SOLAR: A COMPONENT-BASED FRAMEWORK USING UTILITY-SCALE DATA
affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Jordan University of Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign and University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

detail.title: QUANTIFYING THE SYSTEM VALUE OF DISTRIBUTED SOLAR: A COMPONENT-BASED FRAMEWORK USING UTILITY-SCALE DATA
detail.abstract: Distributed photovoltaic (PV) capacity in the United States has expanded rapidly in recent years and is expected to continue growing as solar represents a large share of new electricity-generation additions. Net Energy Metering (NEM) has historically been the dominant policy mechanism used to compensate and incentivize distributed PV adoption. As of 2025, at least 44 U.S. states have enacted some form of net-metering policy, although several jurisdictions have transitioned to successor tariffs or alternative compensation structures [1]. Recent policy activity indicates that nearly all states are actively revisiting distributed solar compensation frameworks, with dozens of regulatory actions addressing revisions to NEM, solar valuation studies, and rate-design reforms [1]. Concerns motivating these investigations include the extent to which retail-rate NEM reflects the system value of distributed PV and whether it creates potential cost-shift equity issues among customers. To support the development of compensation frameworks that more accurately reflect the grid value of distributed PV, this paper develops a transparent, consistent, and repeatable component-based Value of Solar (VoS) methodology. The proposed framework quantifies key value streams associated with distributed PV and is applied using actual operational and planning data from a large investor-owned utility in the Midwestern United States, including distribution system models for two major operating regions within the utility’s service territory. First, we used that utility’s 2025 NEM compensation rules and studied the distributed energy resource billing data and tariff documentation, and established a baseline for NEM, that systems interconnected prior to 2025 receive a 16.09 ¢/kWh bill credit. Second, we calculated the avoided energy component using 8,760-hour locational marginal prices (LMPs) combined with hourly PV generation derived from area-specific irradiance data. Third, we calculated VoS components that include avoided generation capacity, avoided transmission capacity, avoided distribution capacity, and environmental benefits. Results indicate a total VoS of 12.55 ¢/kWh, with energy and environmental benefits representing the largest contributions. A sensitivity analysis shows that the effective load carrying capability (ELCC) and the distribution loss factor are the most influential parameters. The results demonstrate that the proposed methodology provides a defensible and transparent framework for distributed solar valuation that can support regulatory decision-making and future compensation mechanism design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种透明、一致且可重复的太阳能价值（VoS）评估方法，通过分析美国中西部大型投资者拥有的公用事业公司的实际运营与规划数据，量化分布式光伏的电网价值。研究发现，分布式光伏的总价值为12.55美分/千瓦时，其中能源和环境效益贡献最大，而有效载荷能力（ELCC）和配电损耗因子是最敏感的参数。该框架可为监管决策和未来补偿机制设计提供支持。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个透明、一致且可重复的分布式光伏价值（Value of Solar, VoS）评估方法，以更准确地反映分布式光伏的电网价值，支持监管决策和补偿机制设计？
AI.motivation: 净计量（NEM）是美国分布式光伏补偿的主要政策机制，但截至2025年，已有至少44个州实施某种形式的净计量政策，许多司法管辖区正在过渡到替代补偿结构。监管机构关注的问题包括零售净计量是否反映了分布式光伏的电网系统价值，以及是否产生客户之间的成本转移公平性问题。因此，需要一种更准确、可重复的分布式光伏价值评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组件的太阳能价值（Value of Solar, VoS）方法学，包括：避免能源成本（基于8760小时节点边际电价LMP与光伏发电数据）、避免发电容量、避免输电容量、避免配电容量以及环境效益。
AI.method: 采用基于组件的VoS评估方法，应用美国中西部大型投资者拥有的公用事业公司的实际运营与规划数据（包括两个主要运营区域的配电系统模型）。首先，基于2025年NEM补偿规则建立基准（16.09美分/千瓦时账单抵扣）。其次，使用8760小时LMP结合区域辐照度数据计算避免能源成分。最后，计算避免发电容量、输电容量、配电容量和环境效益等VoS组件，并进行敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 分布式光伏的总VoS为12.55美分/千瓦时，低于NEM基准（16.09美分/千瓦时），其中能源和环境效益贡献最大。敏感性分析表明，有效载荷能力（ELCC）和配电损耗因子是最敏感的参数。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种透明、一致且可重复的组件式VoS评估方法学，为分布式光伏的电网价值量化提供了系统框架，揭示了各价值组件的相对贡献及关键参数敏感性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了基于实证数据的分布式光伏补偿机制设计依据，支持更准确地反映分布式光伏实际电网价值的政策制定，有助于解决成本转移公平性问题。

title: Anchored Intrinsic Coordinates for Grokking: Curvature, Predictive Reducibility, and Boundary Cases
affiliations: Clevix AI Research

detail.title: Anchored Intrinsic Coordinates for Grokking: Curvature, Predictive Reducibility, and Boundary Cases
detail.abstract: We study the geometry of grokking trajectories in normalised intrinsic coordinates (u, w), where u rescales log V t between memorisation and validation-transition reference points and w rescales the angular displacement α t from the memorisation direction. Reading the postmemorisation dynamics through the lens of fast-slow systems, we ask whether grokking trajectories collapse onto a 1-D slow manifold in (u, w), with structured deviations diagnostic of where the reduction breaks down. Five complementary findings emerge from 204 trajectories spanning 5 architectures, 2 modular arithmetic tasks, 6 hyperparameter cells per architecture, 3 seeds per cell, and 24 sparse-parity trajectories as a negative control. (F1) First-order affine backbone on three architectures. On 1L Transformer, 3L Transformer, and MLP shallow, the empirical shape follows the constant-rate slowmanifold limit w ≈ 1-u: per-architecture per-trajectory mean slope lies in [-1.05,-0.97] and intercept in [+0.94, +0.99], with per-trajectory R 2 mean ≥ 0.88. Three independent null models (random-monotone, within-trajectory u-w decoupling, and cross-trajectory profile swap) consistently support identifiability: 90.8% of empirical trajectories below the random-monotone null median, 100% below the decoupling null median, and 49.2% on the cross-trajectory swap test (≈ 50%, the outcome supporting intra-family shape consistency). (F2) Second-order curvature correction across all five architectures. The residual u + w-1 exhibits a systematic concave-down deviation pattern (CDP): the median residual is negative for u ∈ [0.3, 0.7] on every architecture (range-0.18 to-0.06), opposite to the random-monotone null (+0.17), and qualitatively consistent with a perturbative correction (Corollary 2) under bell-shaped empirical G(α). The important finding is not exact linearity but the structured failure of linearity: F2 is more architecture-robust than F1 in the sense that the architecture that least supports F1 (MLP deep) exhibits the largest CDP magnitude. (F3, negative control) Path-length separation. The integrated path length L combined separates grokked modular trajectories from sparse-parity trajectories with zero overlap (separation factor 9.22×, Mann-Whitney p = 3.91 • 10-11); sparse parity has no contraction phase and correctly fails to produce a shape function. (F4) Predictive content. Fitting Corollary 2's first-order G(α) on the first 20% of post-memorisation trajectory and forward-integrating predicts log V ⋆ within 5-31% relative error on 4 of 6 architectures (best: MLP shallow, 4.9%, 8.3× tighter than naive). (F5) Manifold single-valuedness diagnostic. We define SVI = 1-E[Var(w | u)]/Var(w) as a coordinate-aware test of slow-manifold reducibility. Computed at three scales (per-trajectory, within-cell, pooled), SVI cleanly separates 5 architectures with robust slow-manifold reducibility (SVI ≥ 0.90 at every scale) from MLP deep (0.975 per-trajectory but 0.573 pooled), revealing MLP deep's boundary behaviour as cell-dependence of the manifold's parametrisation rather than its absence. F5 unifies four previously disconnected MLP-deep observations (slope-1.16, largest CDP, lowest R 2 , smallest F4 advantage) as projections of one underlying property. A 12-cell sensitivity grid over post-hoc thresholds confirms F1 robustness; we pre-register a 7-criterion audit and all seven pass.

AI.tldr: 本文通过204条轨迹、5种架构的实验，系统研究了"grokking"（顿悟）现象在归一化内禀坐标下的几何结构。核心发现是：后记忆阶段的动力学轨迹会坍缩到一条近似线性的1维慢流形上（w ≈ 1-u），但更重要的是这种线性并非完美——所有架构都存在系统性的曲率偏差（CDP）。研究还通过负对照（稀疏奇偶性任务）、预测验证、以及单值性诊断（SVI）等五组发现，揭示了grokking的几何本质及其架构间差异。
AI.research_question: Grokking轨迹在归一化内禀坐标(u, w)下是否坍缩到一维慢流形？如果存在，其几何形状是什么？偏离该流形的结构偏差能否被诊断并解释不同架构间的差异？
AI.motivation: Grokking现象（网络先过拟合再突现泛化）背后的几何机制尚不清晰。已有研究多关注何时发生grokking，但对其"如何"在表示空间中展开的几何结构缺乏定量刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 快慢动力系统（fast-slow systems）理论；归一化内禀坐标(u, w)变换；扰动理论（Corollary 2）用于曲率校正。
AI.method: 204条轨迹，覆盖5种架构（1L Transformer、3L Transformer、MLP shallow、MLP deep、另1种架构）、2种模算术任务、6个超参数单元×3种子×24条稀疏奇偶性负对照轨迹。采用随机单调零模型、轨迹内u-w解耦零模型、跨轨迹剖面交换零模型进行统计检验。
AI.findings: (F1) 1L Transformer、3L Transformer、MLP shallow上轨迹接近线性w≈1-u（斜率均值[-1.05,-0.97]，截距[+0.94,+0.99]，R²≥0.88）。(F2) 所有5种架构均存在系统性的凹形曲率偏差（CDP），u∈[0.3,0.7]时残差中位数为负。(F3) 负对照：路径长度L可完全分离grokking与稀疏奇偶性轨迹（分离因子9.22×）。(F4) 用轨迹前20%数据预测log V*，4/6架构相对误差5-31%。(F5) 单值性诊断指标SVI揭示MLP deep的特殊性：per-trajectory SVI高(0.975)但pooled SVI低(0.573)，说明其慢流形存在单元依赖性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在归一化内禀坐标下精确定量描述了grokking的几何结构，揭示了其近似线性但非完美线性的本质；提出了单值性诊断指标(SVI)作为慢流形可还原性的坐标感知检验方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了预测grokking后验证损失的方法（利用前20%轨迹），潜在可用于早停策略设计；系统性的架构比较为选择更易发生grokking的架构提供了实证依据。

title: From Lifeline to Location Geographic Fragmentation, Mobility, and Crisis Response Equity Within the 988 System Working Paper
affiliations: University of La Verne

detail.title: From Lifeline to Location Geographic Fragmentation, Mobility, and Crisis Response Equity Within the 988 System Working Paper

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known personal or financial conflicts of interest related to this research. The views and analysis presented in this working paper are solely those of the author and are intended for academic and policy discussion purposes.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This working paper did not involve human subjects research, clinical trials, patient data, or direct participant interaction. All information analyzed within this paper was derived from publicly available government reports, policy documents, legislative materials, and publicly accessible research sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The working paper was independently developed by the author as part of ongoing academic and policy research interests in public administration, behavioral health systems, and crisis response infrastructure.

detail.abstract:
The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline represents a major shift in national behavioral health crisis policy by creating a universally accessible three-digit number for individuals experiencing mental health emergencies. However, while 988 established a nationally recognized access point, the infrastructure supporting crisis response remains uneven across states and regions. This working paper argues that the primary limitation of the 988 system is not conceptual, but operational. Specifically, fragmented implementation structures, inconsistent backend crisis infrastructure, workforce shortages, technological limitations, and geographic disparities continue to shape the quality and continuity of crisis response across the United States.

Drawing upon implementation theory, comparative state analysis, and emerging crisis response data, this paper examines how disparities in funding mechanisms, mobile crisis availability, stabilization infrastructure, and operational readiness create unequal access to behavioral health crisis services. The paper further explores how geographic fragmentation and increasing societal mobility challenge traditional crisis routing frameworks that remain heavily dependent upon localized infrastructure and area-code-based systems.

In addition, this paper introduces maternal mental health and postpartum depression as a high-need population lens through which broader implementation inequities become particularly visible. By examining the intersection of crisis governance, infrastructure equity, and vulnerable populations, this research argues that 988 should be understood not merely as a hotline policy but as a national crisis infrastructure policy.

Ultimately, this paper contends that the long-term success of 988 will depend on whether policymakers are willing to move beyond symbolic policy adoption and invest in coordinated, equitable, and modernized crisis response systems capable of delivering meaningful intervention regardless of geography.

AI.tldr: 本文指出988自杀与危机生命线虽然建立了全国统一的危机热线号码，但其运作效果受制于各州和地区碎片化的实施结构、资金不均、基础设施不足、劳动力短缺和技术局限，未能实现真正的服务公平。文章提出应将988视为国家危机基础设施政策，并通过孕产妇心理健康这一高需求群体案例揭示了更深层的实施不平等。
AI.research_question: 988危机生命线系统在实施过程中面临哪些结构性障碍？这些障碍如何导致行为健康危机服务的不平等？如何通过基础设施视角重新理解988政策？
AI.motivation: 988自杀与危机生命线是美国国家行为健康危机政策的重大转变，但其实际运作效果远未达到预期。作者认为问题的根源不在于概念设计，而在于实施层面的碎片化和不平等，亟需系统分析并指出改进路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实施理论（Implementation Theory）、比较州级分析（Comparative State Analysis）、新兴危机响应数据、基础设施公平理论（Infrastructure Equity）、危机治理（Crisis Governance）
AI.method: 基于实施理论的分析框架；跨州比较分析；整合新兴危机响应数据；以孕产妇心理健康为高需求人群案例进行透镜式分析。
AI.findings: 988系统的主要局限是操作性的而非概念性的；资金机制、移动危机服务可用性、稳定化基础设施和操作准备度的差异导致危机服务获取不平等；地理碎片化和社会流动性增加挑战了依赖本地基础设施和区号系统的传统危机路由框架；孕产妇心理健康案例揭示了更广泛的实施不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将988重新概念化——从单纯的热线政策升级为国家危机基础设施政策；提出"基础设施公平"作为评估危机响应系统的关键理论维度；通过高需求人群视角揭示了实施不平等的交叉性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁政策制定者超越象征性政策采纳，投资于协调、公平和现代化的危机响应系统；为改善988系统的跨州协调、资金分配和基础设施标准化提供分析依据；特别关注孕产妇心理卫生这一被忽视的高需求群体。

title: Learning from Imbalanced Fleet Data: GAN-Based Rare Failure Synthesis for Predictive Maintenance of Commercial Bus Fleets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Learning from Imbalanced Fleet Data: GAN-Based Rare Failure Synthesis for Predictive Maintenance of Commercial Bus Fleets

AI.tldr: 针对商用车队预测性维护中罕见故障样本严重不足的问题，提出一种基于多生成器条件GAN的罕见故障合成框架，在450辆公交车18个月数据（仅47个罕见故障）上将罕见刹车系统故障召回率从0.32提升至0.78，精确率保持在0.71以上，全车队误报减少44%。
AI.research_question: 如何解决商用车队预测性维护中因罕见故障样本极度不平衡导致的高漏报率和意外 roadside 故障问题？
AI.motivation: 商用车队预测性维护面临严重类别不平衡问题——灾难性故障（如刹车阀卡死、变速箱锁死）发生频率远低于正常操作，导致高假阴性率和意外路边抛锚，亟需有效方法平衡训练分布。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件多生成器对抗网络（Conditional Multi-Generator Adversarial Network）；基于车辆型号、路线地形和驾驶员模式的条件生成机制。
AI.method: 提出GAN-based罕见故障合成框架：采用多个专用生成器，分别以车辆型号、路线地形和驾驶员模式为条件，生成代表罕见故障模式的真实时间序列传感器数据。通过条件多生成器对抗网络为每种运营环境生成多样化故障轨迹，重新平衡训练分布。
AI.findings: 在450辆公交车18个月数据（仅47个罕见故障）上验证：罕见刹车系统故障召回率从0.32提升至0.78，精确率保持在0.71以上；全车队误报减少44%；合成样本使缺乏历史故障数据的小型车队也能开发有效的预测模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出多上下文GAN故障合成方法，相较于传统过采样（SMOTE、ADASYN）和单生成器GAN，显著提升了罕见故障的检测性能；为预测性维护中的类别不平衡问题提供了新的解决思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商用车队提供了一条实现可靠预测性维护的实用路径，提高了车队可用性并减少了灾难性路边事件；使没有历史故障数据的小型车队也能构建有效预测模型。

title:
Stable Matchings
An Analysis of the Stable Marriage, Hospitals/Residents and Stable Roommates Problems

detail.title:
Stable Matchings
An Analysis of the Stable Marriage, Hospitals/Residents and Stable Roommates Problems
detail.abstract:
This project aims to introduce the Stable Marriage Problem, the Hospitals/Residents Prob-
lem and the Stable Roommates Problem along with their most relevant properties and appli-
cations.
     The Stable Marriage Problem considers two equally sized sets of men and women, where
each man is looking to marry a woman and each woman is looking to marry a man. Each
person has a strictly ordered list of their preferences and the goal is to obtain a stable marriage
or as it will be called, a stable matching. A stable matching is a one-to-one pairing between
the set of men and the set of women with no man and woman who would leave their assigned
pair to marry each other. We introduce an algorithm that finds stable matchings and we show
that there can be a multitude of stable matchings. We explore their properties and consider
what matchings would be advantageous to the men or the women, how many stable matchings
can there be and how can different stable matchings be related to each other. We prove these
results and illustrate them through explicit examples.
     The Hospitals/Residents Problem can be described as an extension of the Stable Marriage
Problem. It considers a set of medical school students that have to be matched to a set of
hospitals for their residency. While each resident is matched to exactly one hospital, each
hospital will be matched with at least one student. The criterion for stability is equivalent
to the case of the Stable Marriage Problem. We introduce two algorithms that find stable
matchings for this problem. We prove comparable results for the Hospitals/Residents Problem
akin to those of the Stable Marriage Problem and illustrate them through thorough examples.
      The Stable Roommates Problem is a generalisation of the Stable Marriage Problem. It
considers a single set containing an even number of people, where each person ranks everyone
else in a preference list and needs to be matched with someone else in the same set. A matching
entails dividing the set into separate pairs with no overlap and it is considered unstable when
there exist two persons that are not matched to each other, each of whom prefers the other over
their respective partners in the matching. We use the properties described in the section on
the Stable Marriage Problem to construct a two-phase algorithm that finds stable matchings
for this problem. We prove the most fundamental properties and apply the framework of the
Stable Roommates Problem in a scenario that involves matching coworkers on projects based
on their work performance. The scenario aims to enquire ways for a company to match their
employees in a way that maximises productivity.

AI.tldr: 本文系统介绍了稳定匹配问题中的三个经典模型：稳定婚姻问题、医院/住院医师问题和稳定室友问题，涵盖其定义、算法、性质及实际应用。
AI.research_question: 如何在不同匹配场景下（一对一双边匹配、多对一双边匹配、单集合内配对）找到稳定的匹配方案？
AI.motivation: 稳定匹配问题在劳动力市场、教育分配、组织配对等现实场景中具有广泛的应用价值，理解不同变体下的稳定匹配算法和性质有助于解决实际资源配置问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稳定匹配理论（Stable Matching Theory），包括Gale-Shapley算法及其扩展、偏好排序的严格性、稳定性的定义（无阻断对）。
AI.method: 理论证明与示例分析相结合。对每个问题分别给出求解稳定匹配的算法（如延迟接受算法、两阶段算法），并通过显式示例验证算法的正确性和性质。
AI.findings: 1）稳定婚姻问题中存在多种稳定匹配，且不同匹配对男性和女性的利益不同；2）医院/住院医师问题可视为稳定婚姻问题的扩展，具有类似的性质；3）稳定室友问题通过两阶段算法可找到稳定匹配，并可用于员工配对以最大化生产力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统比较了三种稳定匹配问题的异同，统一了稳定性概念的表达，并证明了各模型下稳定匹配的存在性和结构性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为劳动力市场匹配（如医学院毕业生与医院配对）、组织内员工配对（如项目搭档分配）提供了理论指导和算法支持，有助于实现更高效、更稳定的资源配置。

title: Owning With Style: How Corporate Owners Shape Firm Strategy
affiliations: Wharton School, University of Penn

detail.title: Owning With Style: How Corporate Owners Shape Firm Strategy

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from the Mack Institute for Innovation Management is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: While management research traditionally views corporate owners as governance actors, recent work suggests they also drive complex organizational change that requires distinct capabilities to implement. I investigate how owners implement their strategy across portfolio firms by examining employee mobility within private equity portfolios. Using career history and work activity data for over 8.7 million employees across 12,775 firms receiving first-ever private equity investment in 2001-2021, I document three findings. First, following investment, portfolio firms increase hiring from their new owner's prior portfolio firms, particularly into managerial, finance, and operations roles. Second, this common-owner hiring is more prevalent under owners who emphasize strategic growth, and less prevalent under those focused on financial engineering. Third, a firm's organizational focus converges toward that of other firms in the same portfolio after investment, but primarily when the firm also hires common-owner employees. These findings indicate a relational mechanism through which owners shape firms: they build a network of trusted talent and deploy it into new portfolio firms to implement their owner-specific strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了私募股权所有者如何通过人才流动（即从已有投资组合公司向新收购公司派遣员工）来实施其战略，发现所有者利用其信任的人才网络来推动组织变革和战略整合。
AI.research_question: 私募股权所有者如何通过员工流动在其投资组合公司中实施战略？
AI.motivation: 传统管理研究将企业所有者视为治理角色，但近期研究表明所有者还推动复杂的组织变革，需要特定能力来实施。然而，所有者如何在多个投资组合公司间实施其战略的机制尚不清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系机制（relational mechanism）——所有者通过构建信任人才网络并将其部署到新投资组合公司来实施所有者特定战略。
AI.method: 使用2001-2021年间首次获得私募股权投资的12,775家公司的870万+员工的职业历史和工作活动数据，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）投资后，组合公司从原所有者旗下其他组合公司招聘员工的比例增加，尤其是管理、财务和运营岗位；（2）关注战略增长的所有者更倾向这种招聘，关注金融工程的所有者则更少；（3）投资后公司组织重点会向组合内其他公司趋同，但这主要发生在那些雇佣了共同所有者员工的公司中。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了所有者通过人才网络部署来实施战略的"关系机制"，拓展了企业所有权与组织变革的理论；将员工流动视为所有者战略传导渠道而非仅仅是劳动力市场现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私募股权所有者如何有效整合和转型被投企业提供策略启示；提醒管理者和投资者关注人才流动在所有权战略实施中的关键作用。
